data.name: npc_dota_hero_antimage
data.bio_loc: The monks of Turstarkuri watched the rugged valleys below their mountain monastery as wave after wave of invaders swept through the lower kingdoms. Ascetic and pragmatic, in their remote monastic eyrie they remained aloof from mundane strife, wrapped in meditation that knew no gods or elements of magic. Then came the Legion of the Dead God, crusaders with a sinister mandate to replace all local worship with their Unliving Lord's poisonous nihilosophy. From a landscape that had known nothing but blood and battle for a thousand years, they tore the souls and bones of countless fallen legions and pitched them against Turstarkuri. The monastery stood scarcely a fortnight against the assault, and the few monks who bothered to surface from their meditations believed the invaders were but demonic visions sent to distract them from meditation. They died where they sat on their silken cushions. Only one youth survived--a pilgrim who had come as an acolyte, seeking wisdom, but had yet to be admitted to the monastery. He watched in horror as the monks to whom he had served tea and nettles were first slaughtered, then raised to join the ranks of the Dead God's priesthood. With nothing but a few of Turstarkuri's prized dogmatic scrolls, he crept away to the comparative safety of other lands, swearing to obliterate not only the Dead God's magic users--but to put an end to magic altogether.
data.hype_loc: Should Anti-Mage have the opportunity to gather his full strength, few can stop his assaults. Draining mana from enemies with every strike or teleporting short distances to escape an ambush, cornering him is a challenge for any foe.
data.npe_desc_loc: Slashes his foes with mana-draining attacks

abilities.name: antimage_mana_break
abilities.desc_loc: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
abilities.lore_loc: A modified technique of the Turstarkuri monks' peaceful ways is to turn magical energies on their owner.
notes_loc: Mana Break has %illusion_percentage%%% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.

abilities.name: antimage_blink
abilities.desc_loc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
abilities.lore_loc: In his encounter with the Dead Gods, Anti-Mage learned the value of being elusive.
notes_loc: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
abilities.scepter_loc: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within %empowered_mana_break_duration%s burns an additional %empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.

abilities.name: antimage_counterspell
abilities.desc_loc: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
abilities.lore_loc: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.
notes_loc: Break disables the passive magic resistance.
abilities.shard_loc: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
facets_loc: Counterspell burns a percentage of the countered spell's mana cost from its caster and does damage based on %damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%% of the burned mana cost, up to a maximum of %max_damage_from_mana_drain% damage per reflected spell.

abilities.name: antimage_persectur
abilities.desc_loc: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.
notes_loc: Full effect if caused by illusions.

abilities.name: antimage_mana_void
abilities.desc_loc: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.
abilities.lore_loc: After bringing enemies to their knees, Anti-Mage punishes them for their use of the arcane arts.
notes_loc: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
facets_loc:
Passively grants attack damage when an enemy hero's mana falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their mana falls further.

If the enemies mana falls below %threshold_pct%%% Anti-Mage gains the maximum amount of damage, as well as vision and True Sight of that hero. Applies to enemy heroes within %thirst_range% range. Bonuses stack per hero.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_axe
data.bio_loc: As a grunt in the Army of Red Mist, Mogul Khan set his sights on the rank of Red Mist General. In battle after battle he proved his worth through gory deed. His rise through the ranks was helped by the fact that he never hesitated to decapitate a superior. Through the seven year Campaign of the Thousand Tarns, he distinguished himself in glorious carnage, his star of fame shining ever brighter, while the number of comrades in arms steadily dwindled. On the night of ultimate victory, Axe declared himself the new Red Mist General, and took on the ultimate title of 'Axe.' But his troops now numbered zero. Of course, many had died in battle, but a significant number had also fallen to Axe's blade. Needless to say, most soldiers now shun his leadership. But this matters not a whit to Axe, who knows that a one-man army is by far the best.
data.hype_loc: One after another, Axe cuts down his foes. Marching ahead of his team, he locks his enemies in battle then counters their blows with a deadly spin of his weapon. Slamming his culling blade through a weakened enemy, he is always charging onward.
data.npe_desc_loc: Taunts and forces enemies to attack him

abilities.name: axe_berserkers_call
abilities.desc_loc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
abilities.lore_loc: Mogul Khan's warcry taunts opponents into engaging in an unconquerable battle with the Axe.
abilities.shard_loc: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.
facets_loc: Berserker's Call gives Axe increased bonus armor and increases the attack speed of the affected units.

abilities.name: axe_battle_hunger
abilities.desc_loc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
abilities.lore_loc: Ordinary heroes cannot withstand Mogul Khan's rage for battle, such that it injures them until it is satisfied.
notes_loc: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.
abilities.shard_loc: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.

abilities.name: axe_counter_helix
abilities.desc_loc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
abilities.lore_loc: Axe is the only reinforcement this army needs.
notes_loc: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.
abilities.scepter_loc: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

abilities.name: axe_culling_blade
abilities.desc_loc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
abilities.lore_loc: Mogul Khan is the embodiment of battle and fury, launching into a gruesome fatality against those who dare engage the Axe in combat.
notes_loc: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.

abilities.name: axe_one_man_army
abilities.desc_loc: Axe gains Strength based on %armor_pct_as_strength%%% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within %radius% distance from Axe.  The effect fades over %bonus_linger_duration%s after approaching an ally.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_axe_culling_blade_speed_duration
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_speed_duration}s Culling Blade Kill Buff Bonus Duration

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_axe_8
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_speed_bonus}% Movement Speed per active Battle Hunger

data.name: npc_dota_hero_bane
data.bio_loc: When the gods have nightmares, it is Bane Elemental who brings them.  Also known as Atropos, Bane was born from the midnight terrors of the goddess Nyctasha.  A force of terror too powerful to be contained by sleep, he surfaced from her slumbers, fed upon her immortality, and stole his vaporous form from her inky blood.  He is the essence of fear.  Mortals who hear his voice hear their darkest secrets whispered in their ear.  He calls to the hidden fear in every Hero's heart.  Wakefulness is no protection, for Bane's black blood, continuously dripping, is a tar that traps his enemies in nightmare.  In the presence of Bane, every Hero remembers to fear the dark.
data.hype_loc: Bane brings terror to his enemies with his arsenal of disabling abilities. Whether trapping a foe within a contagious nightmare, or gripping an enemy in place, he gives allies all the time they need to slay their enemy.
data.npe_desc_loc: Puts his enemies to sleep, incapacitating them

abilities.name: bane_enfeeble
abilities.desc_loc: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
abilities.lore_loc: Each tendril of fear that Atropos weaves increases the vulnerability of his victims to arcane and unknown arts.

abilities.name: bane_brain_sap
abilities.desc_loc: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
abilities.lore_loc: Atropos finds no greater pleasure than to harvest the fear he creates.
abilities.shard_loc: Reduces cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%. Causes Brain Sap to become a %shard_radius% AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for %shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%.

abilities.name: bane_nightmare
abilities.desc_loc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
abilities.lore_loc: A stolen prowess from the goddess Nyctasha is to put his prey into forever sleep.
notes_loc: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
facets_loc: Bane has increased attack speed when attacking Nightmared units.
Nightmared units walk in Bane's chosen direction.

abilities.name: bane_fiends_grip
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every %fiend_grip_tick_interval% seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
abilities.lore_loc: Victims of Atropos are frequently torn apart by vivid conjurations of their own nightmares.
abilities.scepter_loc: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take %scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

abilities.name: bane_ichor_of_nyctasha
abilities.desc_loc: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker
data.bio_loc: Strygwyr the Bloodseeker is a ritually sanctioned hunter, Hound of the Flayed Twins, sent down from the mist-shrouded peaks of Xhacatocatl in search of blood. The Flayed Ones require oceanic amounts of blood to keep them sated and placated, and would soon drain their mountain empire of its populace if the priests of the high plateaus did not appease them. Strygwyr therefore goes out in search of carnage. The vital energy of any blood he lets, flows immediately to the Twins through the sacred markings on his weapons and armor. Over the years, he has come to embody the energy of a vicious hound; in battle he is savage as a jackal. Beneath the Mask of the Bloodseeker, in the rush of bloody quenching, it is said that you can sometime see the features of the Flayers taking direct possession of their Hound.
data.hype_loc: Bloodseeker forces difficult decisions on his enemies. Able to drive his foes to a retreat by bathing a large area with a damaging ritual, his gruesome ultimate asks his opponents to hold still, or die.
data.npe_desc_loc: Chases down low health enemies with increased speed

abilities.name: bloodseeker_bloodrage
abilities.desc_loc: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
abilities.lore_loc: Strygwyr shares his animalistic thirst for bloodshed.
notes_loc: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.
abilities.shard_loc: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal %max_health_dmg_pct%%% of the target's max health as <font color="#d8ae53">Pure</font> damage.

abilities.name: bloodseeker_blood_bath
abilities.desc_loc: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After %delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip% seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
abilities.lore_loc: The Flayed Twins are ever willing to aid those who spill blood upon the field of battle.
notes_loc: Total time is a %delay% second delay plus a %abilitycastpoint% second cast time.

abilities.name: bloodseeker_thirst
abilities.desc_loc: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below %invis_threshold_pct%%%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
abilities.lore_loc: Strygwyr becomes frenzied when blood is spilled.
notes_loc: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below %max_bonus_pct%%%.
Effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds if a target dies.
facets_loc: Can be activated to grant bonus movement speed and %sanguivore_multiplier%x Sanguivore heal bonus for a short duration. While on cooldown, passive Thirst move speed is reduced by %inactive_penalty_pct%%% . Cannot be cast when all enemy heroes are at full health.

abilities.name: bloodseeker_sanguivore
abilities.desc_loc:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to %base_heal% health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.
notes_loc: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%.

abilities.name: bloodseeker_rupture
abilities.desc_loc: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
abilities.lore_loc: When the Bloodseeker hunts you, injuries become fatalities.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases initial damage and grants %AbilityCharges% Rupture Charges.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden
data.bio_loc: Born in a temperate realm, raised with her fiery older sister Lina, Rylai the Crystal Maiden soon found that her innate elemental affinity to ice created trouble for all those around her. Wellsprings and mountain rivers froze in moments if she stopped to rest nearby; ripening crops were bitten by frost, and fruiting orchards turned to mazes of ice and came crashing down, spoiled. When their exasperated parents packed Lina off to the equator, Rylai found herself banished to the cold northern realm of Icewrack, where she was taken in by an Ice Wizard who had carved himself a hermitage at the crown of the Blueheart Glacier. After long study, the wizard pronounced her ready for solitary practice and left her to take his place, descending into the glacier to hibernate for a thousand years. Her mastery of the Frozen Arts has only deepened since that time, and now her skills are unmatched.
data.hype_loc: Able to keep her allies supplied with mana as she slows down enemies to ensure a kill, Crystal Maiden is a helpful addition to any team. And, when the opportunity arises, she can unleash her massive ultimate ability to devastate her foes.
data.npe_desc_loc: Unleashes a high damage blizzard upon her foes

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_nova
abilities.desc_loc: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
abilities.lore_loc: The air temperature around Rylai drops rapidly, chilling all around her to the core.
notes_loc: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.
facets_loc: Crystal Nova has increased radius and grants allied heroes a physical damage barrier. Barrier is increased for Crystal Maiden.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_frostbite
abilities.desc_loc: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals %creep_multiplier%x damage to non-ancient creeps.
abilities.lore_loc: Rylai channels winds from the Blueheart Glacier, imprisoning attackers in thick blocks of ice.
notes_loc: Frostbite is considered a root.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura
abilities.desc_loc:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a %proximity_bonus_radius% radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.
abilities.lore_loc: Cold temperatures promote the essence of magic, causing Rylai's presence to allow spell usage in abundance.
facets_loc: Activating Arcane Aura temporarily increases Crystal Maiden's spell amplification and mana costs. During the duration, Crystal Maiden restores her own and her allies' Mana when casting spells. Does not affect items. Duration is paused while channeling Freezing Field.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_clone
abilities.desc_loc: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
abilities.lore_loc: So convincing that some allies have spent minutes talking to the clone before they realized she wasn't speaking back.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_glacial_guard
abilities.desc_loc: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_freezing_field
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with %num_explosions% random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Once the place of her exile, Icewrack has become an anchor for Rylai's frigid onslaught.
notes_loc: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts %slow_duration% second).
Explosions occur every %explosion_interval_tooltip% seconds.
abilities.scepter_loc: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move %shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %shard_bonus_explosion%%%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_crystal_maiden_glacial_guard_mana_multiplier
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_mana_multiplier}% Glacial Guard Mana Spent To Barrier

data.name: npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger
data.bio_loc:
Drow Ranger's given name is Traxex--a name well suited to the short, trollish, rather repulsive Drow people. But Traxex herself is not a Drow. Her parents were travelers in a caravan set upon by bandits, whose noisy slaughter of innocents roused the ire of the quiet Drow people.

After the battle settled, the Drow discovered a small girl-child hiding in the ruined wagons, and agreed she could not be abandoned. Even as child, Traxex showed herself naturally adept at the arts they prized: Stealth, silence, subtlety. In spirit, if not in physique, she might have been a Drow changeling, returned to her proper home. But as she grew, she towered above her family and came to think of herself as ugly. After all, her features were smooth and symmetrical, entirely devoid of warts and coarse whiskers.

Estranged from her adopted tribe, she withdrew to live alone in the woods. Lost travelers who find their way from the forest sometimes speak of an impossibly beautiful Ranger who peered at them from deep among the trees, then vanished like a dream before they could approach. Lithe and stealthy, icy hot, she moves like mist in silence. That whispering you hear is her frozen arrows finding an enemy's heart.
data.hype_loc: Not many can escape Drow Ranger once she's within range. After her foes have been silenced with a chilling blast, she finishes them off with a barrage of slowing, ice-tipped arrows that few can survive.
data.npe_desc_loc: Slows with her frost-tipped arrows

abilities.name: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
abilities.desc_loc: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Ice-encased arrows pierce the silence, chilling their victims to the core.
notes_loc: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.
abilities.scepter_loc: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_wave_of_silence
abilities.desc_loc: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.
abilities.lore_loc: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_multishot
abilities.desc_loc:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
abilities.lore_loc: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.
notes_loc: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_glacier
abilities.desc_loc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
abilities.lore_loc: Traxex wasn't just adopted by the Drow, she was adopted by the lands they lived in.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_trueshot
abilities.desc_loc: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received %trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%% of the bonus agility.
abilities.lore_loc: Traxex' time spent alone in the forests of her Drow home has allowed her to teach other archers how to improve their bow skills.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_marksmanship
abilities.desc_loc: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
abilities.lore_loc: The Drow Ranger is the epitome of archery prowess.
notes_loc: Marksmanship procs have true strike.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_earthshaker
data.bio_loc:
Like a golem or gargoyle, Earthshaker was one with the earth but now walks freely upon it. Unlike those other entities, he created himself through an act of will, and serves no other master. In restless slumbers, encased in a deep seam of stone, he became aware of the life drifting freely above him. He grew curious.

During a season of tremors, the peaks of Nishai shook themselves loose of avalanches, shifting the course of rivers and turning shallow valleys into bottomless chasms. When the land finally ceased quaking, Earthshaker stepped from the settling dust, tossing aside massive boulders as if throwing off a light blanket.

He had shaped himself in the image of a mortal beast, and named himself Raigor Stonehoof. He bleeds now, and breathes, and therefore he can die. But his spirit is still that of the earth; he carries its power in the magical totem that never leaves him. And on the day he returns to dust, the earth will greet him as a prodigal son.
data.hype_loc: Whether blocking an enemy's escape, dividing their forces, or shattering the ground beneath gathered foes, Earthshaker is at his best when he strikes without warning. Whatever survives the aftershocks still has a swing from his mighty totem to look forward to.
data.npe_desc_loc: Disrupts enemy team with his chain stuns

abilities.name: earthshaker_fissure
abilities.desc_loc: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
abilities.lore_loc: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.
notes_loc: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
abilities.shard_loc: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
facets_loc: Enemy heroes stunned by Fissure emit an echo to each nearby unit within a %echoes_radius% radius, dealing damage equal to %echoes_damage_multiplier%%% of Echo Slam's current echo damage.

abilities.name: earthshaker_enchant_totem
abilities.desc_loc: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
abilities.lore_loc: Raigor's gorilla strength can destroy mountains.
notes_loc: Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.
abilities.scepter_loc: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.

abilities.name: earthshaker_aftershock
abilities.desc_loc: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
abilities.lore_loc: The earth trembles beneath the mighty footsteps of Raigor.
notes_loc: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.

abilities.name: earthshaker_echo_slam
abilities.desc_loc: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.
abilities.lore_loc: Tectonic plates crack, mountains fold, and foes are crushed by the Echo Slam.

abilities.name: earthshaker_slugger
abilities.desc_loc: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

special_values.heading_loc: FLYING ENEMY'S MAX HEALTH AS DAMAGE:

data.name: npc_dota_hero_juggernaut
data.bio_loc: No one has ever seen the face hidden beneath the mask of Yurnero the Juggernaut. It is only speculation that he even has one. For defying a corrupt lord, Yurnero was exiled from the ancient Isle of Masks--a punishment that saved his life. The isle soon after vanished beneath the waves in a night of vengeful magic. He alone remains to carry on the Isle's long Juggernaut tradition, one of ritual and swordplay. The last practitioner of the art, Yurnero's confidence and courage are the result of endless practice; his inventive bladework proves that he has never stopped challenging himself. Still, his motives are as unreadable as his expression. For a hero who has lost everything twice over, he fights as if victory is a foregone conclusion.
data.hype_loc: In a flurry of slashes, Juggernaut cuts down his foes. Sprinting and spinning into battle with reckless abandon, and nearly invincible once he is able to begin his assault, stopping Juggernaut can often be just as difficult as surviving him.
data.npe_desc_loc: Slices through his enemies with precise strikes

abilities.name: juggernaut_blade_fury
abilities.desc_loc: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
abilities.lore_loc: Yurnero's renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerors alike.
notes_loc: You can use items during Blade Fury.
Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.
abilities.scepter_loc:
Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect.

Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every %attack_interval%s.

abilities.name: juggernaut_healing_ward
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Of the rituals learned at the Isle of Masks, tending wounds with a bit of voodoo magic has proven to be quite useful.
notes_loc: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases ward healing and health.

abilities.name: juggernaut_blade_dance
abilities.desc_loc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
abilities.lore_loc: The last remnant of his heritage's commitment to bladework, Yurnero ensures that the style is remembered.

abilities.name: juggernaut_swift_slash
abilities.desc_loc: Performs a short Omnislash for %duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: A briefer onslaught for those less deserving of the honor.

abilities.name: juggernaut_bladeform
abilities.desc_loc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every %stack_gain_time%s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: juggernaut_omni_slash
abilities.desc_loc:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: 'The fruits of discipline; with practice comes strength.'
notes_loc: You can use items during Omnislash.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_mirana
data.bio_loc: Born to a royal family, a blood princess next in line for the Solar Throne, Mirana willingly surrendered any claim to mundane land or titles when she dedicated herself completely to the service of Selemene, Goddess of the Moon. Known ever since as Princess of the Moon, Mirana prowls the sacred Nightsilver Woods searching for any who would dare poach the sacred luminous lotus from the silvery pools of the Goddess's preserve. Riding on her enormous feline familiar, she is poised, proud and fearless, attuned to the phases of the moon and the wheeling of the greater constellations. Her bow, tipped with sharp shards of lunar ore, draws on the moon's power to charge its arrows of light.
data.hype_loc: As she takes aim from a distance with her deadly arrow, Mirana must always be ready to leap into battle. Able to shield her allies from the eyes of her enemies, she ensures that her team is always on the prowl.
data.npe_desc_loc: Stuns enemies with precise arrows from afar

abilities.name: mirana_starfall
abilities.desc_loc: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a %starfall_secondary_radius% radius will be struck a second time.
abilities.lore_loc: The Goddess breaks the strata to empower her Princess in the time of need.
notes_loc: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.
facets_loc: Starstorm's second meteor deals more damage and blinds the target.

abilities.name: mirana_arrow
abilities.desc_loc: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
abilities.lore_loc: Lunar energies make the Princess of the Moon's arrows more deadly than most.
notes_loc: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
abilities.scepter_loc: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.

abilities.name: mirana_leap
abilities.desc_loc: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts %leap_bonus_duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: None can fail to recognize Mirana's iconic white beast in the heat of battle.
abilities.shard_loc: Grants +%additional_charges% Leap charge.
facets_loc: Upon landing, Leap roots targets in a %root_radius% radius for %root_duration%s.

abilities.name: mirana_celestial_quiver
abilities.desc_loc: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.
abilities.shard_loc: Grants %quiver_restore% temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.

abilities.name: mirana_invis
abilities.desc_loc: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
abilities.lore_loc: Her tenure with Selemene allows Mirana to eclipse the ground, wrapping her allies in a cloak of shadows.
notes_loc: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_mirana_5
talents.desc_loc: Evasion works at all times during the buff
facets_loc: Solar Flare gives +{s:bonus_evasion}% Evasion

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_mirana_2
talents.desc_loc: The extra arrows are launched in a cone shape, {s:bonus_extra_arrows_angle} degrees to the left and right of the original arrow, and cannot hit the same target.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_mirana_4
facets_loc: -{s:bonus_AbilityCooldown}s Solar Flare Cooldown

data.name: npc_dota_hero_morphling
data.bio_loc: For dark eons the comet circled. Held in thrall to a distant sun, bound by gravity's inexorable pull, the massive ball of ice careened through the blackness between worlds, made strange by its dark journey. On the eve of the ancient war of the Vloy, it punched down through the sky and lit a glowing trail across the night, a sign both armies took for an omen. The frozen ball melted in a flash of boiling heat, as below two forces enjoined in battle across the border of a narrow river. Thus freed from its icy stasis, the Morphling was born into conflict, an elemental power at one with the tides of the ocean, capricious and unconstrained. He entered the fight, instinctively taking the form of the first general who dared set foot across the water, and then struck him dead. As the motley warriors clashed, he shifted from form to form throughout the battle, instantly absorbing the ways of these strange creatures--now a footsoldier, now an archer, now the cavalryman--until, by the time the last soldier fell, Morphling had played every part. The battle's end was his beginning.
data.hype_loc: Shifting his attributes to suit his situation, Morphling can be as elusive as he is deadly. Whether riding a wave to flank an enemy, or boosting his health before escaping into his deceptive replication, few can hope to corner him.
data.npe_desc_loc: Rides the waves to flank enemies

abilities.name: morphling_waveform
abilities.desc_loc: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
abilities.lore_loc: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.
facets_loc: Waveform attacks enemies in his path. Does not apply on-hit effects.

abilities.name: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
abilities.desc_loc:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
abilities.lore_loc: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.
notes_loc: Projectile moves at %projectile_speed% speed.
facets_loc: Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength.

abilities.name: morphling_morph_agi
abilities.desc_loc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
abilities.lore_loc: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
notes_loc: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.
abilities.shard_loc: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

abilities.name: morphling_morph_str
abilities.desc_loc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
abilities.lore_loc: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
notes_loc: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.
abilities.shard_loc: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

abilities.name: morphling_replicate
abilities.desc_loc: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
abilities.lore_loc: Staring into Morphling produces a reflection that mimics the beholder.
notes_loc: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
abilities.scepter_loc: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.

abilities.name: morphling_ebb_and_flow
abilities.desc_loc: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
notes_loc: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_nevermore
data.bio_loc: It is said that Nevermore the Shadow Fiend has the soul of a poet, and in fact he has thousands of them. Over the ages he has claimed the souls of poets, priests, emperors, beggars, slaves, philosophers, criminals and (naturally) heroes; no sort of soul escapes him. What he does with them is unknown. No one has ever peered into the Abysm whence Nevermore reaches out like an eel from among astral rocks. Does he devour them one after another? Does he mount them along the halls of an eldritch temple, or pickle the souls in necromantic brine? Is he merely a puppet, pushed through the dimensional rift by a demonic puppeteer? Such is his evil, so intense his aura of darkness, that no rational mind may penetrate it. Of course, if you really want to know where the stolen souls go, there's one sure way to find out: Add your soul to his collection. Or just wait for Nevermore.
data.hype_loc: Capturing souls from every kill he makes, Shadow Fiend is always gathering his power. Every assault, each carefully aimed raze that kills an enemy, brings him closer to unleashing his gathered souls in a deadly blast of scouring energy.
data.npe_desc_loc: Unleashes the souls of fallen enemies for damage

abilities.name: nevermore_shadowraze1
abilities.desc_loc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
abilities.lore_loc: Nevermore's trademark for harvesting souls.
notes_loc: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
abilities.shard_loc: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
facets_loc: Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.

abilities.name: nevermore_frenzy
abilities.desc_loc:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.
abilities.lore_loc: For Nevermore, there's as much delight in the harvest as there is in the feast.

abilities.name: nevermore_dark_lord
abilities.desc_loc: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
abilities.lore_loc: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one's soul.
notes_loc: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.
facets_loc: Presence of the Dark Lord temporarily reduces more armor after nearby enemy heroes are killed.

abilities.name: nevermore_requiem
abilities.desc_loc:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
abilities.lore_loc: The captured souls of those past slain are released to ravage their former allies.
notes_loc: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
abilities.scepter_loc: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

abilities.name: nevermore_necromastery
abilities.desc_loc: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
abilities.lore_loc: Harvested souls swirl in and out of the Abysm, empowering the Shadow Fiend to increase the size of his collection.
notes_loc: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases max souls.
facets_loc: Every hero kill increases max souls by %max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill% until Shadow Fiend dies.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_frenzy_max_collection_count
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_soul_collection_per_hero} Feast of Souls Souls Collected Per Hero

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_6
talents.desc_loc: Max Fear duration increased by +{s:bonus_requiem_slow_duration_max}s

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_frenzy_castspeed
talents.name_loc: Feast of Souls Grants +{s:bonus_cast_speed_pct}% Cast Speed

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_raze_procsattacks
talents.desc_loc: Does not apply attack modifiers.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer
data.bio_loc:
The remote village of Pole had no knowledge of the wars raging in the heart of the kingdom. For them, the quiet of spear fishing, and a family meal were all that a full life required. Yet war came for them nonetheless. Joining the able-bodied conscripts as they filed passed their homes, the humble lancer Azwraith vowed to bring peace to his kingdom, and in so doing, his people. Placed with his kin in the vanguard of the final assault against the Dread Magus Vorn, the cost to his fellows was absolute. As the charging force battled toward the fortress, Azwraith alone among his kind remained standing, and he alone was able to infiltrate the keep.

Focused and infuriated by the slaughter of his brothers, Azwraith bested each of the wizard's deadly traps and conjured guardians. Soon the simple fisherman arrived at Vorn's tower sanctum. The pair dueled through the night, pike to staff, as chaos raged below, and with a deafening cry Azwraith pierced his enemy. But the wizard did not simply expire; he exploded into uncountable shards of light, penetrating his killer with power. As the dust settled and the smoke of combat began to clear, Azwraith found himself standing among a throng of his kin. Each seemed to be dressed as he was, each seemed armed as he was, and he could sense that each thought as he did. Aware that his allies were approaching, he willed these phantoms to hide themselves, and one by one they began to vanish into nothingness. As the soldiers came upon the sanctum, they found the warrior that had bested the wizard. When they approached their champion, the lancer vanished. The pikeman who had stood before them was no more than another phantom.
data.hype_loc: Phantom Lancer storms enemy forces with an endless supply of clones. Leading his illusory army, he can cut foes apart in a breathtaking flurry of attacks, send clones to push into enemy territory, or use his doppelgangers to mislead and elude foes if cornered.
data.npe_desc_loc: Creates illusions of himself to trick or attack foes

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
abilities.desc_loc: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
abilities.lore_loc: Azwraith's proficiency at spearing his family's meal of fish is proving quite useful in the battlefield.
notes_loc: Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.
abilities.scepter_loc: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.
facets_loc: Spirit Lances from Phantom Lancer's illusions deal %illusion_lance_damage_pct%%% Lance Damage.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
abilities.desc_loc:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: Dread Magus Vorn's death imbued the Phantom Lancer with the ability to bend and fracture all spectrums of light.
notes_loc: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
facets_loc: Spawns an additional illusion per %hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%% of health that Phantom Lancer is missing.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
abilities.desc_loc: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
abilities.lore_loc: Azwraith knows that on the field of battle, speed can mean everything.
notes_loc: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is %bonus_speed%.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for %duration% seconds.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
abilities.desc_loc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Each of Azwraith's lance attacks feels like two from a normal warrior; or three; or four...
abilities.shard_loc: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
facets_loc: Juxtapose Illusions spawn on random nearby units and deal more damage but can't be controlled.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_phantom_lancer_illusion_lances
talents.desc_loc: Spirit Lances from illusions hit for a percentage of the normal damage amount

data.name: npc_dota_hero_puck
data.bio_loc: While Puck seems at first glance a mischievous, childish character, this quality masks an alien personality. The juvenile form of a Faerie Dragon, a creature that lives for eons, Puck spends countless millennia in its childish form. So while it is technically true that Puck is juvenile, it will continue to be so when the cities of the present age have sloughed away into dust. Its motives are therefore inscrutable, and what appears to be play may in fact hide a darker purpose. Its endless fondness for mischief is the true indicator of Puck's true nature.
data.hype_loc: Puck has a talent for confounding its enemies with playfully elusive mischief. By teleporting to its damaging orb in order to hop short distances, it attacks foes with bursts of silencing dust. By the time its enemies can react, Puck has long since escaped.
data.npe_desc_loc: Orbs to enemies and silences them

abilities.name: puck_illusory_orb
abilities.desc_loc:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed. At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
abilities.lore_loc: The playful Faerie Dragon delights in confusing others, vanishing and reappearing where unexpected.
notes_loc: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

abilities.name: puck_waning_rift
abilities.desc_loc: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
abilities.lore_loc: With a mischievous grin, Puck spreads its enchanted powder which disrupts magical flow.
facets_loc: Waning Rift pushes enemies away. If the ability is in alt-cast state, it will pull them instead.

abilities.name: puck_phase_shift
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
abilities.lore_loc: With a quip and flash, Puck returns to the alien dimension from whence it came.
notes_loc: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
abilities.shard_loc: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.

abilities.name: puck_puckish
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores %mana_and_health_restore_pct%%% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores %dodged_spell_multiplier%x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

abilities.name: puck_dream_coil
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
abilities.lore_loc: The Faerie Dragon sows confusion by forcing its enemies to vividly dream about their own mortality.
abilities.scepter_loc: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_pudge
data.bio_loc: In the Fields of Endless Carnage, far to the south of Quoidge, a corpulent figure works tirelessly through the night--dismembering, disembowelling, piling up the limbs and viscera of the fallen that the battlefield might be clear by dawn. In this cursed realm, nothing can decay or decompose; no corpse may ever return to the earth from which it sprang, no matter how deep you dig the grave. Flocked by carrion birds who need him to cut their meals into beak-sized chunks, Pudge the Butcher hones his skills with blades that grow sharper the longer he uses them. Swish, swish, thunk. Flesh falls from the bone; tendons and ligaments part like wet paper. And while he always had a taste for the butchery, over the ages, Pudge has developed a taste for its byproduct as well. Starting with a gobbet of muscle here, a sip of blood there...before long he was thrusting his jaws deep into the toughest of torsos, like a dog gnawing at rags. Even those who are beyond fearing the Reaper, fear the Butcher.
data.hype_loc: Each carefully aimed throw of Pudge's signature hook strikes fear into his foes. Pulling his enemies near to carve them with his cleavers, he gains additional health and damage with every kill, and soon becomes an unstoppable killer.
data.npe_desc_loc: Hooks and pulls enemies towards him

abilities.name: pudge_meat_hook
abilities.desc_loc: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
abilities.lore_loc: The Butcher's hook is a symbolic nightmare, its curved blade a frightening reminder of his slaughterous intent.
notes_loc: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
abilities.shard_loc:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
facets_loc: Meat Hook deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled, but base damage is reduced.

abilities.name: pudge_rot
abilities.desc_loc: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
abilities.lore_loc: A foul odor precedes a toxic, choking gas, emanating from the Butcher's putrid, ever-swelling mass.
notes_loc: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Rot radius by %bonus_rot_radius%, damage by %bonus_rot_damage%, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%.

abilities.name: pudge_flesh_heap
abilities.desc_loc: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.
abilities.lore_loc: The Butcher gives new meaning to the words 'meat shield.'

abilities.name: pudge_innate_graft_flesh
abilities.desc_loc: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining %flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount% bonus Strength for each stack.
notes_loc: Enemy Heroes that die within %flesh_heap_range% of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.

abilities.name: pudge_dismember
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.
abilities.lore_loc: 'When I'm through with these vermin, they'll be fit for a pie!'
notes_loc: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
facets_loc: Dismember increases Strength when dealing damage to heroes.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_pudge_1
talents.name_loc: {s:bonus_flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount}x Flesh Heap and Meat Shield bonuses

data.name: npc_dota_hero_razor
data.bio_loc: Among the emblematic powers that populate the Underscape, Razor the Lightning Revenant is one of the most feared. With his whip of lightning, he patrols the Narrow Maze, that treacherous webwork of passages by which the souls of the dead are sorted according to their own innate intelligence, cunning and persistence. Drifting above the Maze, Razor looks down on the baffled souls below, and delivers jolts of scalding electricity that both punish and quicken the souls as they decide their own fates, hurrying on toward luminous exits or endlessly dark pits. Razor is the eternal embodiment of a dominating power, abstract and almost clinical in his application of power. Yet he has a lordly air that suggests he takes a sardonic satisfaction in his work.
data.hype_loc: With a deadly lightning storm at his command, Razor charges into battle. Deploying a sweeping ring of electrified plasma to fry his enemies, he links with foes to drain them of their power and use it against them.
data.npe_desc_loc: Steals enemy damage to add to his own

abilities.name: razor_plasma_field
abilities.desc_loc: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
abilities.lore_loc: The Lightning Revenant rules the Underscape with plasmatic power.

abilities.name: razor_static_link
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
abilities.lore_loc: Razor's polarity channels electricity into his being, draining the power of his opposition.
notes_loc: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes %drain_range_buffer% units greater than Static Link's cast range.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by %move_speed_factor%x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.

abilities.name: razor_storm_surge
abilities.desc_loc: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
abilities.lore_loc: Merely approaching the Lightning Revenant is rewarded with shock therapy.
notes_loc: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.shard_loc: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.

abilities.name: razor_unstable_current
abilities.desc_loc: Passively increases Razor's movement speed.

abilities.name: razor_eye_of_the_storm
abilities.desc_loc: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
abilities.lore_loc: Ride the lightning.
notes_loc: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.
abilities.scepter_loc: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_razor_2
talents.name_loc: -{s:bonus_strike_interval}s Eye of the Storm Strike Interval

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_razor_plasmafield_second_ring
talents.name_loc: Creates A Second Plasma Field Delayed By {s:bonus_second_ring_delay}s
talents.desc_loc: The second plasma field does {s:bonus_second_ring_reduction}% less damage

data.name: npc_dota_hero_sand_king
data.bio_loc: The sands of the Scintillant Waste are alive and sentient--the whole vast desert speaks to itself, thinking thoughts only such a vastness can conceive. But when it needs must find a form to communicate with those of more limited scope, it frees a fragment of itself, and fills a carapace of magic armor formed by the cunning Djinn of Qaldin. This essential identity calls itself Crixalis, meaning 'Soul of the Sand,' but others know it as Sand King.  Sand King takes the form of a huge arachnid, inspired by the Scintillant Waste's small but ubiquitous denizens; and this is a true outward expression of his ferocious nature. Guardian, warrior, ambassador--Sand King is all of these things, inseparable from the endless desert that gave him life.
data.hype_loc: Not many can survive an ambush from Sand King. Demolishing everything around him with waves of deadly vibration from his ultimate, he evades counterattacks by hiding himself in a scouring gust of sand, and stuns foes by striking them from beneath.
data.npe_desc_loc: Burrows to stun and slow enemies

abilities.name: sandking_burrowstrike
abilities.desc_loc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
abilities.lore_loc: Crixalis often lies in wait, burrowing under the surface to ambush his adversaries.
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: sandking_sand_storm
abilities.desc_loc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
abilities.lore_loc: Some say Crixalis is a mirage; his carapace appearing then vanishing between the whirling sands of the Scintillant Waste.
notes_loc: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.
facets_loc: Sand Storm has increased radius and grants Sand King Invisibility while in it.

Sand Storm follows Sand King at a rate of %sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%% of his movement speed and is still active at a distance of up to %sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster% units away from Sand King.
When Sand King attacks enemies in Sand Storm, he applies a blinding debuff to the target.

abilities.name: sandking_scorpion_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
abilities.lore_loc: Crixalis is certainly capable of mercy, but the soul of the sand finds few foes worth sparing.
abilities.shard_loc: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.

abilities.name: sandking_caustic_finale
abilities.desc_loc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.
abilities.lore_loc: An injection from Crixalis makes one brittle and as dry as the arid wastes, subject to implosive demise.

abilities.name: sandking_epicenter
abilities.desc_loc: After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
abilities.lore_loc: Many an explorer was lost to the quicksands of the Scintillant Waste.
notes_loc: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.
abilities.shard_loc: Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
abilities.scepter_loc: When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_sand_king_4
talents.desc_loc: Enemy units in range of Sand Storm have their movement speed slowed by {s:bonus_sand_storm_slow}% and miss {s:bonus_blind_pct}% of their attacks.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit
data.bio_loc: Storm Spirit is literally a force of nature--the wild power of wind and weather, bottled in human form. And a boisterous, jovial, irrepressible form it is! As jolly as a favorite uncle, he injects every scene with crackling energy. But it was not always thus, and there was tragedy in his creation. Generations ago, in the plains beyond the Wailing Mountains, a good people lay starving in drought and famine. A simple elementalist, Thunderkeg by name, used a forbidden spell to summon the spirit of the storm, asking for rain. Enraged at this mortal's presumption, the Storm Celestial known as Raijin lay waste to the land, scouring it bare with winds and flood. Thunderkeg was no match for the Celestial--at least until he cast a suicidal spell that forged their fates into one: he captured the Celestial in the cage of his own body. Trapped together, Thunderkeg's boundless good humor fused with Raijin's crazed energy, creating the jovial Raijin Thunderkeg, a Celestial who walks the world in physical form.
data.hype_loc: Storm Spirit is never one to miss a fight. Zipping from across the battlefield in a bolt of lightning, he strikes enemies from every direction with exploding remnants and charged attacks, then disappears while his enemies are still scrambling to react.
data.npe_desc_loc: Zips across the map to engage in fights

abilities.name: storm_spirit_static_remnant
abilities.desc_loc: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for %abilityduration% seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.
abilities.lore_loc: Raijin Thunderkeg's duality allows him to admire himself in shocking fashion.
notes_loc: Remnants take %static_remnant_delay% second to materialize after the spell is cast.
Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
The explosion actually hits units in a %static_remnant_damage_radius% radius, but will only be triggered in %static_remnant_radius%.
Can be self-cast to cast in place.

abilities.name: storm_spirit_electric_vortex
abilities.desc_loc: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
abilities.lore_loc: Raijin's thunderous, boisterous energy often draws others into an electrifying situation.
abilities.scepter_loc: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.
facets_loc: Electric Vortex applies a debuff to the enemy that lasts for %enemy_overload_duration%s making their next attack target themself and trigger an Overload Charge.

abilities.name: storm_spirit_overload
abilities.desc_loc: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
abilities.lore_loc: Pow!  Zip!  Zap!
notes_loc: Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
Overload charges do not stack.
abilities.shard_loc: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes %shard_activation_charges% Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to %shard_activation_duration% seconds or until the charges are depleted.

abilities.name: storm_spirit_ball_lightning
abilities.desc_loc: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
abilities.lore_loc: The Storm is coming in.
notes_loc: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.

abilities.name: storm_spirit_galvanized
abilities.desc_loc: Storm Spirit gains a charge of %mp_per_kill% mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every %level_divisor% levels. Loses %charges_per_death% charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains %perma_mp_per_kill% Mana Regen permanently.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_storm_spirit_7
talents.desc_loc: Bouncing attacks deal {s:bonus_overload_damage_pct}% damage.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_storm_spirit_4
talents.name_loc: {s:bonus_auto_remnant_interval} Distance Auto Remnant in Ball Lightning
talents.desc_loc: Every {s:bonus_auto_remnant_interval} distance travelled in Ball Lightning creates a Static Remnant.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_sven
data.bio_loc: Sven is the bastard son of a Vigil Knight, born of a Pallid Meranth, raised in the Shadeshore Ruins.  With his father executed for violating the Vigil Codex, and his mother shunned by her wild race, Sven believes that honor is to be found in no social order, but only in himself.  After tending his mother through a lingering death, he offered himself as a novice to the Vigil Knights, never revealing his identity.  For thirteen years he studied in his father's school, mastering the rigid code that declared his existence an abomination.  Then, on the day that should have been his In-Swearing, he seized the Outcast Blade, shattered the Sacred Helm, and burned the Codex in the Vigil's Holy Flame.  He strode from Vigil Keep, forever solitary, following his private code to the last strict rune. Still a knight, yes...but a Rogue Knight. He answers only to himself.
data.hype_loc: Sven is always eager to charge into a fight. He stuns grouped enemies as he wades into battle, and once he ignites his damage-boosting ultimate, a few swings of his massive sword are often more than enough to slay his foes.
data.npe_desc_loc: Cleaves down enemies with his incredible strength

abilities.name: sven_storm_bolt
abilities.desc_loc: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
abilities.lore_loc: The Rogue Knight's iron gauntlet, taken from the school of his father, strikes his foes to their core.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

abilities.name: sven_great_cleave
abilities.desc_loc: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.
abilities.lore_loc: The Vigil Knights still seek to reclaim the stolen Outcast Blade from Sven, a weapon capable of cutting wide swaths through lesser warriors.

abilities.name: sven_warcry
abilities.desc_loc: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts %duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Calling a few lines from the Vigil Codex fortifies Sven's obedience to his rogue code. So poetic!
abilities.shard_loc: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.

abilities.name: sven_gods_strength
abilities.desc_loc: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for %abilityduration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: With the strength that shattered the Sacred Helm, the Rogue Knight stands unopposed in melee combat.
notes_loc: The bonus damage is based on base damage and the primary attribute of Sven.

abilities.name: sven_wrath_of_god
abilities.desc_loc: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_sven_stormhammer_cooldown
talents.name_loc: -{s:bonus_AbilityCooldown}% Storm Hammer Cooldown and Mana Cost

data.name: npc_dota_hero_tiny
data.bio_loc: Coming to life as a chunk of stone, Tiny's origins are a mystery on which he continually speculates.  He is a Stone Giant now, but what did he used to be?  A splinter broken from a Golem's heel?  A shard swept from a gargoyle-sculptor's workshop?  A fragment of the Oracular Visage of Garthos?  A deep curiosity drives him, and he travels the world tirelessly seeking his origins, his parentage, his people.  As he roams, he gathers weight and size; the forces that weather lesser rocks, instead cause Tiny to grow and ever grow.
data.hype_loc: Growing to tremendous size and strength as the battle progresses, Tiny's power can quickly become terrifying. He tosses heroes and creeps at his enemies, or stuns them beneath an avalanche. Should he gather his full strength, he can demolish the enemy's base with ease.
data.npe_desc_loc: Grows in size and strength as battle ensues

abilities.name: tiny_avalanche
abilities.desc_loc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
abilities.lore_loc: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.

abilities.name: tiny_toss
abilities.desc_loc: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
abilities.lore_loc: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.
notes_loc: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
Flight time is %duration%s.

abilities.name: tiny_tree_grab
abilities.desc_loc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
abilities.lore_loc: Sticks and stones break all the bones, with structures sure to follow.
notes_loc: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

abilities.name: tiny_tree_channel
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
abilities.lore_loc: Sticks thrown from stones are like to shatter many bones.

abilities.name: tiny_insurmountable
abilities.desc_loc: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
notes_loc: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.

abilities.name: tiny_grow
abilities.desc_loc: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
abilities.lore_loc: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.
abilities.shard_loc: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

abilities.name: tiny_toss_tree
abilities.desc_loc: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.
abilities.lore_loc: Even enemies can share in Tiny's arbor ardor.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_tiny_5
talents.desc_loc: Toss can target the ground as well as enemy units.
