data.name: npc_dota_hero_vengefulspirit
data.bio_loc: Even the most contented Skywrath is an ill-tempered creature, naturally inclined to seek revenge for the slightest insult. But Vengeful Spirit is the essence of vengeance. Once a proud and savage Skywrath scion, Shendelzare was first in succession for the Ghastly Eyrie until a sister's treachery robbed her of her birthright. Snared in an assassin's net, Shendelzare tore free only at the cost of her wings, limping away in the ultimate humiliation: On foot. With her wings broken, she knew the Skywrath would never accept her as ruler; and in the highest roost of the Eyrie, inaccessible except by winged flight, her sister was untouchable. Unwilling to live as a flightless cripple, and desiring revenge far more than earthly power, the fallen princess drove a bargain with the goddess Scree'Auk: She surrendered her broken body for an imperishable form of spirit energy, driven by vengeance, capable of doing great damage in the material plane. She may spend eternity flightless, but she will have her revenge.
data.hype_loc: Vengeful Spirit's presence is felt at all times, whether she is alive or dead. Able to swap positions with any nearby hero, stun enemies, and reduce her killer's effectiveness if she falls, she constantly brings confusion and chaos to her foes.
data.npe_desc_loc: Can swap herself with any nearby hero

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_magic_missile
abilities.desc_loc: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
abilities.lore_loc: A simple Skywrath technique, the magic missile is Shendel's primary tool for vengeance.
abilities.shard_loc: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within %bounce_range_pct%%% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.
facets_loc: Magic Missile deals %damage_per_lasthit% bonus damage for every creep the enemy has killed.

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror
abilities.desc_loc: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
abilities.lore_loc: Shendel's haunting voice hints at her approaching vindication.

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_command_aura
abilities.desc_loc: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
abilities.lore_loc: Although they may not share her undying passion for revenge, allies do draw on her fanaticism in combat.
notes_loc: Break disables the damage aura.
abilities.scepter_loc:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_retribution
abilities.desc_loc:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals %bonus_damage%%% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
abilities.desc_loc: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
abilities.lore_loc: Martyrdom is a small price to pay for vengeance.
notes_loc: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_vengeful_spirit_wave_of_terror_steal
talents.name_loc: Wave Of Terror Steals {s:bonus_steal_pct}% Of Reduced Damage And Armor

data.name: npc_dota_hero_windrunner
data.bio_loc: The western forests guard their secrets well. One of these is Lyralei, master archer of the wood, and favored godchild of the wind.  Known now as Windranger, Lyralei's family was killed in a storm on the night of her birth--their house blown down by the gale, contents scattered to the winds. Only the newborn survived among the debris field of death and destruction.  In the quiet after the storm, the wind itself took notice of the lucky infant crying in the grass. The wind pitied the child and so lifted her into the sky and deposited her on a doorstep in a neighboring village.  In the years that followed, the wind returned occasionally to the child's life, watching from a distance while she honed her skills.  Now, after many years of training, Windranger fires her arrows true to their targets.  She moves with blinding speed, as if hastened by a wind ever at her back.  With a flurry of arrows, she slaughters her enemies, having become, nearly, a force of nature herself.
data.hype_loc: Evasive and swift, the nimble Windranger is always seeking the right angle to attack. Whether she's clearing the way with a draw of her deadly powershot, or shackling enemies together to pepper them with arrows, she's always on the move.
data.npe_desc_loc: Fires swift flurry of arrows at a single target

abilities.name: windrunner_shackleshot
abilities.desc_loc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
abilities.lore_loc: Windranger's variety of bow skills includes an arrow with thick ropes attached to encumber any escaping target.
notes_loc: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.
facets_loc: Shackleshot applies to all units and trees behind the target unit and grants Windranger bonus attack damage for each additional shackled unit and tree. Creeps and trees grant less bonus damage.

abilities.name: windrunner_powershot
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
abilities.lore_loc: During her early years of training, Lyralei learned to fire powerful arrows that cleaved even trees to reach their targets.
notes_loc: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
facets_loc: Enemy heroes hit are executed if below a health threshold. The execute threshold is based on the arrow's power.

abilities.name: windrunner_windrun
abilities.desc_loc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.
abilities.lore_loc: Lyralei enchants gusts of winds to fight incoming attacks.

abilities.name: windrunner_gale_force
abilities.desc_loc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.
abilities.lore_loc: At last Lyralei has learned to call upon the might of her true birthright.

abilities.name: windrunner_focusfire
abilities.desc_loc: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
abilities.lore_loc: Lyralei's ability to bombard opponents with a flurry of arrows is unparalleled - even at the expense of accuracy.
notes_loc: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.
facets_loc: Focus Fire no longer requires a target, instead firing at random enemies within Windranger's attack range + %bonus_range%. Fires a fixed number of attacks per second, and can only hit the same enemy every 4 shots. Prioritizes Heroes.

abilities.name: windrunner_tailwind
abilities.desc_loc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
abilities.scepter_loc: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_windranger_7
talents.name_loc: Powershot Executes Enemy Heroes Under {s:bonus_max_execute_threshold}% Max HP
talents.desc_loc: Execute Threshold ranges from {s:bonus_min_execute_threshold}% to {s:bonus_max_execute_threshold}% Max HP based on the arrow's power.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_windranger_2
talents.name_loc: Focus Fire Kills Advance Cooldown by {s:bonus_cooldown_reduction_per_kill}s

data.name: npc_dota_hero_zuus
data.bio_loc: Lord of Heaven, father of gods, Zeus treats all the Heroes as if they are his rambunctious, rebellious children. After being caught unnumbered times in the midst of trysts with countless mortal women, his divine wife finally gave him an ultimatum: 'If you love mortals so much, go and become one. If you can prove yourself faithful, then return to me as my immortal husband. Otherwise, go and die among your creatures.' Zeus found her logic (and her magic) irrefutable, and agreed to her plan. He has been on his best behavior ever since, being somewhat fonder of immortality than he is of mortals. But to prove himself worthy of his eternal spouse, he must continue to pursue victory on the field of battle.
data.hype_loc: None can hide from Zeus, whether he's calling down a bolt to reveal the surroundings, sending an arc coursing through his nearest enemies, or summoning a terrifying volley of lightning upon all enemies. Wherever his foes are, Zeus will find them.
data.npe_desc_loc: Strikes enemies near and far with lightning

abilities.name: zuus_arc_lightning
abilities.desc_loc: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.
abilities.lore_loc: Arc Lightning is Zeus' favorite spell to use against puny mortals.

abilities.name: zuus_lightning_bolt
abilities.desc_loc: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
abilities.lore_loc: A shocking punishment for rebellious heathen.
notes_loc: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.

abilities.name: zuus_heavenly_jump
abilities.desc_loc: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Though temporarily barred from the heavens, Zeus can still manage a measure of godly flight.

abilities.name: zuus_cloud
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
abilities.lore_loc: Where the thunder god's ire grows, storm clouds quickly gather.
notes_loc: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.

abilities.name: zuus_lightning_hands
abilities.desc_loc: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
abilities.lore_loc: A helping hand from Aghanim lets the fallen Lord of Heaven tap into some of his old strengths.

abilities.name: zuus_thundergods_wrath
abilities.desc_loc: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
abilities.lore_loc: The Lord of Heaven smites all who oppose him, near or far.
facets_loc: Damage is dealt to one enemy at a time, moving from lowest health hero to highest. If an enemy is killed by this ability, the damage for all subsequent enemies is increased.

abilities.name: zuus_static_field
abilities.desc_loc: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
abilities.lore_loc: The air crackles with static when the Thundergod walks the world.
facets_loc: Static Field deals more damage to nearby enemies.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_kunkka
data.bio_loc:
As The Admiral of the mighty Claddish Navy, Kunkka was charged with protecting the isles of his homeland when the demons of the Cataract made a concerted grab at the lands of men. After years of small sorties, and increasingly bold and devastating attacks, the demon fleet flung all its carnivorous ships at the Trembling Isle. Desperate, the Suicide-Mages of Cladd committed their ultimate rite, summoning a host of ancestral spirits to protect the fleet. Against the demons, this was just barely enough to turn the tide.

As Kunkka watched the demons take his ships down one by one, he had the satisfaction of wearing away their fleet with his ancestral magic. But at the battle's peak, something in the clash of demons, men and atavistic spirits must have stirred a fourth power that had been slumbering in the depths. The waves rose up in towering spouts around the few remaining ships, and Maelrawn the Tentacular appeared amid the fray. His tendrils wove among the ships, drawing demon and human craft together, churning the water and wind into a raging chaos.

What happened in the crucible of that storm, none may truly say. The Cataract roars off into the void, deserted by its former denizens. Kunkka is now The Admiral of but one ship, a ghostly rig which endlessly replays the final seconds of its destruction. Whether he died in that crash is anyone's guess. Not even Tidehunter, who summoned Maelrawn, knows for sure.
data.hype_loc: Kunkka is always predicting where his enemies will go next. Able to attack a location with a geyser of water or a ghostly shipwreck, should his aim prove true, he and his allies will have no trouble cleaning up whatever is left.
data.npe_desc_loc: Disrupts enemy positioning and disables them

abilities.name: kunkka_torrent
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
abilities.lore_loc: An ancestral rush of water explodes from the center of the world, called upon by the Admiral.
notes_loc: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.

abilities.name: kunkka_tidebringer
abilities.desc_loc: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
abilities.lore_loc: A lost Claddish soul inhabits Kunkka's trusty Tidebringer, empowering it to destroy demons of the Cataract.
facets_loc: Tidebringer cooldown is reduced per enemy hero it hits.

abilities.name: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot
abilities.desc_loc: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
abilities.lore_loc: The Admiral's set of arcane abilities includes some that can be used for battle as well as entertainment.
facets_loc: When X Marks the Spot returns its target, Kunkka and allies near the return spot gain Ghostship's Admiral's Rum buff.

abilities.name: kunkka_admirals_rum
abilities.desc_loc: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below %damage_threshold%%% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to %ghostship_absorb%%% of incoming damage for %buff_duration%s.
abilities.lore_loc: Deleterious to landlubbers, no one holds their rum like a sailor.
notes_loc: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

abilities.name: kunkka_tidal_wave
abilities.desc_loc: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.
abilities.lore_loc: A good sailor knows the timing of the tides like the back of his hand.

abilities.name: kunkka_ghostship
abilities.desc_loc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
abilities.lore_loc: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.
notes_loc: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.
abilities.scepter_loc: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_lina
data.bio_loc: The sibling rivalries between Lina the Slayer, and her younger sister Rylai, the Crystal Maiden, were the stuff of legend in the temperate region where they spent their quarrelsome childhoods together. Lina always had the advantage, however, for while Crystal was guileless and naive, Lina's fiery ardor was tempered by cleverness and conniving. The exasperated parents of these incompatible offspring went through half a dozen homesteads, losing one to fire, the next to ice, before they realized life would be simpler if the children were separated. As the oldest, Lina was sent far south to live with a patient aunt in the blazing Desert of Misrule, a climate that proved more than comfortable for the fiery Slayer. Her arrival made quite an impression on the somnolent locals, and more than one would-be suitor scorched his fingers or went away with singed eyebrows, his advances spurned. Lina is proud and confident, and nothing can dampen her flame.
data.hype_loc: As deadly as she is fragile, Lina effortlessly strikes down any foe foolish enough to be caught alone. Gaining attack speed with each spell she casts, she scours enemies with flame and heat lightning, ensuring few can survive her assaults.
data.npe_desc_loc: Increases attack and speed with every spell

abilities.name: lina_dragon_slave
abilities.desc_loc: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
abilities.lore_loc: In the scorched barren of Misrule, Lina learned to manipulate the fiery breath of the Desert Wyrm as a form of entertainment.
notes_loc: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: lina_light_strike_array
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
abilities.lore_loc: Lina's essence allows her to focus the sun's energies, causing air to combust at will.
notes_loc: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.

abilities.name: lina_fiery_soul
abilities.desc_loc: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts %fiery_soul_stack_duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Dancing flames embody Lina's playful nature, bringing out her true blazing self.
notes_loc: Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.

abilities.name: lina_flame_cloak
abilities.desc_loc: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
abilities.lore_loc: A natural defense equally suited to keeping anything from unwanted sisters to snarling hellbeasts at bay.

abilities.name: lina_slow_burn
abilities.desc_loc: Lina's abilities deal an additional %burn_damage_pct%%% damage as burn damage over %burn_duration%s.

abilities.name: lina_laguna_blade
abilities.desc_loc: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
abilities.lore_loc: The air around Lina becomes so intensely torrid that it scorches a foe that comes too close with white-hot lightning.
notes_loc: Laguna Blade has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
abilities.shard_loc: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
facets_loc: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lina_4
talents.name_loc: {s:bonus_fiery_soul_magic_resist}% Fiery Soul Magic Resist Per Stack

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lina_7
talents.desc_loc: Increases Slow Burn Damage to {s:bonus_additional_tick_total_damage_tooltip}%

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lina_crit_debuff
talents.name_loc: {s:bonus_target_crit_multiplier}% Attack Crit On Targets Affected By Slow Burn

data.name: npc_dota_hero_lion
data.bio_loc: Once a Grandmaster of the Demon Witch tradition of sorcery, Lion earned fame among his brethren for fighting on the side of light and righteousness. But adulation corrupts. With powers surpassed only by his ambition, the mage was seduced by a demon and turned to evil, trading his soul for prestige. After committing horrible crimes that marred his soul, he was abandoned. The demon betrayed him, striking better deals with his enemies. Such was Lion's rage that he followed the demon back to hell and slew it, ripping it limb from limb, taking its demonic hand for his own. However, such demonoplasty comes at a cost. Lion was transfigured by the process, his body transformed into something unrecognizable. He rose from hell, rage incarnate, slaying even those who had once called him master, and laying waste to the lands where he had once been so adored. He survives now as the sole practitioner of the Demon Witch tradition, and those who present themselves as acolytes or students are soon relieved of their mana and carried off by the faintest gust of wind.
data.hype_loc: Lion gives enemies little chance to retaliate. Stunning targets with a damaging row of spikes, or temporarily transforming them into a harmless critter, even if his powerful spells aren't enough, he and his allies should still have all the time they need to slay their foes.
data.npe_desc_loc: Steals enemy mana to fuel his own abilities

abilities.name: lion_impale
abilities.desc_loc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
abilities.lore_loc: The Demon Witch exercises his demonic covenant, opening a fissure from hell.
notes_loc: The spikes move at %speed% units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: lion_voodoo
abilities.desc_loc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
abilities.lore_loc: Lion is compelled to share his transfiguration, twisting the essence of those who oppose him.
notes_loc: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

abilities.name: lion_mana_drain
abilities.desc_loc:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.

Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
abilities.lore_loc: Lesser magi are nothing more than a source of magical restoration for the Demon Witch.
notes_loc: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
abilities.shard_loc: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
facets_loc: Mana Drain deals damage equal to %damage_pct%%% of mana stolen.

abilities.name: lion_to_hell_and_back
abilities.desc_loc:
Lion gains %debuff_amp%%% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains %spell_amp%%% spell amplification for %duration%s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

abilities.name: lion_finger_of_death
abilities.desc_loc:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills.

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
abilities.lore_loc: Lion's disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.
notes_loc: Finger of Death has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within %grace_period% seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.
abilities.scepter_loc: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lion_11
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_spell_amp}% To Hell And Back Debuff/Spell Amp

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lion_8
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_damage_per_kill} Finger of Death Damage Per Kill

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lion_10
talents.name_loc: Earth Spike affects a 30 degree cone

data.name: npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman
data.bio_loc:
Born in the Bleeding Hills, Rhasta was just a starving youngling when picked up by a travelling con-man. For two pins of copper, the old con-man would tell your fortune. For three, he'd castrate your pig, for five, he'd circumcise your sons. For a good meal, he'd don his shaman garb, read from his ancient books, and lay a curse upon your enemies. His strange new youngling, part hill troll, part...something else, worked as assistant and lent an air of the exotic to the con-man's trade.

Always one step ahead of cheated customers, one town ahead of a pursuing patronage, the two trekked across the blighted lands until one day the con-man realized that the little youngling could actually do what he only pretended at. His ward had a gift--a gift that customers valued. And so the youngling Rhasta was thrust before the crowds, and the trade-name Shadow Shaman was born. The two continued from town to town, conjuring for money as Shadow Shaman's reputation grew. Eventually, the pair's duplicitous past caught up with them, and they were ambushed by a mob of swindled ex-clients. The con-man was slain, and for the first time, Rhasta used his powers for darkness, massacring the attackers. He buried his beloved master, and now uses his powers to destroy any who would seek to do him harm.
data.hype_loc: Shadow Shaman quickly clears the way for his team's forces to march on the enemy base. Blasting enemies with shocking spells and interrupting attackers with hexes, his powerful serpent wards destroy enemy defenses with ease.
data.npe_desc_loc: Summons powerful serpent wards to deal damage

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
abilities.lore_loc: Originally used to open shows with the travelling con-man, Rhasta's lightning display shocks adversaries in more ways than one.
notes_loc: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo
abilities.desc_loc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
abilities.lore_loc: Rhasta often ended performances by turning himself into a chicken - now, the humiliation is shared.
notes_loc: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_shackles
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
abilities.lore_loc: A self-defense incantation, Rhasta developed shackles after his master was slain in the Bleeding Hills.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
abilities.desc_loc:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: Rhasta had to learn early on how to stay one step ahead of those who (rightfully or wrongfully) wished him harm.
notes_loc: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_urnaconda
abilities.desc_loc: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has %megaward_multiplier_tooltip%x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts %ward_duration%s.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward
abilities.desc_loc: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
abilities.lore_loc: Snake charming was a big part of the Shadow Shaman's act; now Rhasta can empower the snakes to do his bidding.
abilities.shard_loc: Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.
facets_loc: Summons a single massive Serpent Ward with %mega_ward_multiplier_damage%x damage and %mega_ward_multiplier_health%x health and bounty values.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_slardar
data.bio_loc: Slardar is a Slithereen, one of the Deep Ones, guardian of a vast network of sunken cities and the ancient riches buried within them. In the lightless gulf of the deepest ocean abysses, the Slithereen Guard patrols secret treasure rooms, ever vigilant against the subaqueous thieves sent into the deeps by covetous dryland sorcerers. He is utterly loyal, and his taciturn nature hides deep knowledge of the most secret places of the sea. He rises to the shallows in spite of the pain caused him by brightness, to commit reconnaissance, to make sure no one is conspiring against the depths, and sometimes in relentless pursuit of the rare few who manage to steal off with an item from the Sunken Treasury. Because he has spent his whole life at great pressure, under tremendous weight of the sea, Slardar the Slithereen Guard is a creature of immense power.
data.hype_loc: Ready to find and demolish his foes, Slardar quickly slithers into battle. After exposing an enemy's position and shattering their defenses, he closes the distance to lock them in place with crushing blows and powerful bashes from his trident.
data.npe_desc_loc: Chases down his enemies to weaken and bash them

abilities.name: slardar_sprint
abilities.desc_loc: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has %slow_resistance_tooltip%%% slow resistance for the first %speed_burst_max_duration%s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
abilities.lore_loc: As Slardar has made the transition from the Deeps, it has been necessary to use his powerful tail for sprinting instead of swimming.
notes_loc: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.
facets_loc: Slardar has slow resistance and even more movement speed at the beginning of Guardian Sprint.

abilities.name: slardar_slithereen_crush
abilities.desc_loc: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
abilities.lore_loc: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.
abilities.shard_loc: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.

abilities.name: slardar_bash
abilities.desc_loc: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
abilities.lore_loc: Thieves of the wealth of the Deep Ones meet the brutality of the Slithereen Guard in melee combat.
notes_loc: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

abilities.name: slardar_seaborn_sentinel
abilities.desc_loc: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.
abilities.scepter_loc: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by %scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%% and puddle/trail duration by %scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%s.

abilities.name: slardar_amplify_damage
abilities.desc_loc: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
abilities.lore_loc: Even the strongest armor counts for little when left to the brine of the sea.
facets_loc: Corrosive Haze increases Slardar's armor by %armor_pct%%% of the total armor reduced.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_tidehunter
data.bio_loc: The Tidehunter known as Leviathan was once the champion of the Sunken Isles, but his motives are as mysterious as those of his people. We all know the importance of the Drylanders' shipping lanes, how empires may rise and fall according to who controls the open water. Far less is known of the submarine lanes, and how the warring tribes of the Meranthic Diaspora have carved out habitations through endless undersea skirmishes. In the fragile treaties between the Mer and Men, we can glimpse the extent of the drowned empires, but their politics appear complex and opaque. It would seem that Leviathan tired of such petty strife, and set off on his own, loyal only to his abyssal god, Maelrawn the Tentacular. He stalks the shallows now in search of men or meranths who stray into his path, and with a particular loathing for Admiral Kunkka, who has long been his nemesis for reasons lost in the deepest trenches of the sea.
data.hype_loc: Stalking ahead of his team, Tidehunter is always on the lookout for the right time to strike. When the moment comes, he unleashes his massive and devastating ultimate, paving the way for his allies to slay their stunned enemies.
data.npe_desc_loc: Durable hero who shrugs off enemy damage

abilities.name: tidehunter_gush
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
abilities.lore_loc: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.
abilities.scepter_loc: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.

abilities.name: tidehunter_kraken_shell
abilities.desc_loc:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.
facets_loc: Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.

abilities.name: tidehunter_anchor_smash
abilities.desc_loc: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
abilities.lore_loc: Stolen from one of Admiral Kunkka's flagships, Leviathan's heavy anchor proves useful as a melee weapon.
notes_loc: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water
abilities.desc_loc: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.
abilities.lore_loc: Anchors Aweigh!

abilities.name: tidehunter_ravage
abilities.desc_loc: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
abilities.lore_loc: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.
notes_loc: Ravage will hit invisible units.
Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.

abilities.name: tidehunter_leviathans_catch
abilities.desc_loc:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
notes_loc: Enemies can destroy the fish.
Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_tidehunter_smash_on_blubber
talents.name_loc: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash
talents.desc_loc: Triggered attack has {s:bonus_smash_on_purge}% damage and is reflected damage.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_tidehunter_10
talents.desc_loc: Deals {s:bonus_building_pct_damage}% damage to buildings.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor
data.bio_loc: A wiry silhouette hitches forward--uneven of feature and limb, bizarre of gait, relentlessly criss-crossing the battlefield in search of that vital weak point where his talents can do most good, and most harm. Whether broken or mismade it is not clear, but still, none can doubt the power carried in his twisted physique. A long staff thumps the earth as Zharvakko the Witch Doctor advances, deploying a terrifying arsenal of fetishes, hexes and spells.  It is a body of magical knowledge learned and perfected over several lifetimes in the island highlands of Arktura, now wielded with precision accuracy against his enemies. Zharvakko can be your best friend or your worst enemy--healing allies and laying waste to all who oppose him.
data.hype_loc: Witch Doctor is whatever his team needs him to be. Whether aiding his team with gradual healing, stunning and cursing foes to ensure a kill, or destroying enemies himself with a dance by his mighty ultimate, few can match Witch Doctor's versatility.
data.npe_desc_loc: Channels a high damage death ward

abilities.name: witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask
abilities.desc_loc: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
abilities.lore_loc: The Witch Doctor recycles the bones of fallen friends and foes, using the powder as part of his arsenal of charms and alchemy.
notes_loc: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.
facets_loc: Paralyzing Cask deals more damage each bounce.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration
abilities.desc_loc: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
abilities.lore_loc: Zharvakko's hocus pocus is not limited only to hexxing his opponents and is quite adept at curing ailments.
notes_loc: Healing is done in %heal_interval% second intervals.
Can heal Spell Immune units.
facets_loc: Voodoo Restoration deals damage to enemies and only heals Witch Doctor.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_maledict
abilities.desc_loc: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
abilities.lore_loc: Certain voodoo magics can make an enemy regret engaging the Witch Doctor.
notes_loc: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.
facets_loc: Enemies who die while cursed deal damage equal to %spread_pct%%% of what the next burst damage would be to all enemy units in a %spread_radius% radius.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo
abilities.desc_loc: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_gris_gris
abilities.desc_loc:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip%s.

Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_death_ward
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
abilities.lore_loc: Witch Doctor performs a ritualistic dance, one that haunts the dreams of those who live to recount it.
notes_loc: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
abilities.scepter_loc: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
facets_loc: Death Ward attacks %initial_target_count% targets at once with reduced damage. The secondary target takes %secondary_attack_damage_pct%%% of the damage.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_witch_doctor_maledict_spread
talents.name_loc: Maledict bursts deal {s:bonus_spread_pct}% damage in a {s:bonus_spread_radius} AoE
talents.desc_loc: Sends projectiles that deal {s:bonus_spread_pct}% of the burst damage at all enemy units within {s:bonus_spread_radius} range

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_witch_doctor_2
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_heal_percent}% Target Max Health Voodoo Restoration Heal
facets_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_heal_percent}% Target Max Health Voodoo Restoration Damage

data.name: npc_dota_hero_lich
data.bio_loc:
In life, the frost-mage Ethreain (not yet a Lich) had used the threat of destructive ice to enslave entire kingdoms. His subjects, aided by a few desperate magicians, eventually grew bold enough to ambush him. Armed with enough charmed rope to bind him forever, they tied the frost mage to adamant weights and dropped him in a pool known chiefly for being bottomless. It wasn't.

He only fell for a year or so before an outcrop snagged him. There he rested, dead but undecaying, until the geomancer Anhil thought to verify the legend of the supposedly bottomless Black Pool. Anhil's plumbline snarled with the ropes that bound the drowned magician, and up he hauled an unexpected prize. Thinking that by rendering the dead undead, he could question the Lich about the properties of the pool, he removed the bindings and commenced a simple rite of resurrection. Even the descendants of Ethreain's enemies were long forgotten by time, so there were none to warn Anhil against imprudence. But he learned the error of his judgment almost immediately, as Lich threw off the shackles and consumed him.
data.hype_loc: Drifting from battle to battle and sacrificing creeps to fuel his assaults, Lich is always ready to help his fellow heroes destroy their enemies with slowing frost. Should his foes be foolish enough to gather, his bouncing ultimate will ensure their demise.
data.npe_desc_loc: Unleashes a powerful attack that bounces between enemies

abilities.name: lich_frost_nova
abilities.desc_loc: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.
abilities.lore_loc: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.

abilities.name: lich_frost_shield
abilities.desc_loc: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
abilities.lore_loc: First conceived of to protect him in his mortal years, the frost magic that Ethreain weaves around himself has only grown colder with time.
notes_loc: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.
facets_loc: Whenever an enemy dies under the effect of Frost Shield, its duration is increased.

abilities.name: lich_sinister_gaze
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
abilities.lore_loc: Mind the cold...
abilities.scepter_loc: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

abilities.name: lich_ice_spire
abilities.desc_loc:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take %max_hero_attacks% hero hits or %max_creep_attacks% creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.
abilities.lore_loc: The waters within the Black Pool remain liquid far below the point of freezing and immediately crystallize when removed.

abilities.name: lich_death_charge
abilities.desc_loc:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
notes_loc: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

abilities.name: lich_chain_frost
abilities.desc_loc: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
abilities.lore_loc: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreain's orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.
notes_loc: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
facets_loc: Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
Killing an enemy with Chain Frost increases the number of bounces.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lich_6
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_radius} Frost Blast Radius and Area Damage

data.name: npc_dota_hero_riki
data.bio_loc: Riki was born middle child to the great dynasty of Tahlin. With an older brother groomed for the throne, and a younger brother coddled and kept, Riki, the small middle son, seemed born for the art of invisibility.  It was an art he cultivated, and one which ultimately saved his life on the night that his people were betrayed and his family slaughtered. Of all the royal line, he alone escaped, small and agile, unassuming, using smoke as cover. He cut his way out of the royal grounds, using the advantage of surprise, quietly slitting the throats of one enemy warrior after another. Now free of his royal responsibilities, Riki uses his talents in service to a new trade: Stealth Assassin. He silences his enemies, sharpening his skills, hoping to one day take revenge on those who killed his family and robbed him of his birthright.
data.hype_loc: Riki stalks the battlefield, unseen by the enemy. He chooses his moment carefully and bursts forth in a puff of silencing smoke, stabbing at his foes before they even know he's there.
data.npe_desc_loc: Remains permanently invisible until the moment to strike

abilities.name: riki_smoke_screen
abilities.desc_loc: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
abilities.lore_loc: Since his escape during the night of his betrayal, Riki has valued the use of a simple smoke screen to confuse his opponents.
notes_loc: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
abilities.shard_loc: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.

abilities.name: riki_blink_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
abilities.lore_loc: The Stealth Assassin's agile movement makes him impossible to escape.

abilities.name: riki_tricks_of_the_trade
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
abilities.lore_loc: The Stealth Assassin is not afraid to fight dirty, and specializes in attacking his opponents from behind.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
facets_loc: Tricks of the Trade has %creep_agility_multiplier%x Agility Bonus when attacking non-hero units. When Riki kills a non-hero unit during Tricks of the Trade, the cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%s.

abilities.name: riki_innate_backstab
abilities.desc_loc: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
notes_loc: Works when denying friendly units at %ally_multiplier%%% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.
facets_loc: Riki receives bonus experience for assists and kills.

abilities.name: riki_backstab
abilities.desc_loc: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.
abilities.lore_loc: Riki comes for you.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_riki_tricks_dmg
talents.name_loc: {s:bonus_base_attack_damage_pct}% of Riki's Base damage added to Tricks of the Trade

data.name: npc_dota_hero_enigma
data.bio_loc:
Nothing is known of Enigma's background. There are only stories and legends, most of them apocryphal, passed down through the ages. In truth, Enigma is a mystery for whom the only true biography is description: he is a universal force, a consumer of worlds. He is a being of the void, at times corporeal, other times ethereal. A beast between the planes.

There are stories that say he was once a great alchemist who tried to unlock the secrets of the universe and was cursed for his arrogance. Other legends tell that he is an ancient being of strange gravity, the abyss personified--a twisted voice from out the original darkness, before the first light in the universe. And there are older legends that say he is the first collapsed star, a black hole grown complicated and sentient--his motivations unknowable, his power inexorable, a force of destruction unleashed upon existence itself.
data.hype_loc: Widely feared for his ultimate ability, Enigma can summon a black hole capable of entrapping enemy forces, so that allies can then destroy them. An ever-present contingent of eidolons at his side, he pummels foes with ranged attacks.
data.npe_desc_loc: Traps and damages enemies in a black hole

abilities.name: enigma_malefice
abilities.desc_loc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Strange gravities pull at the core of those who would oppose you, holding them in place.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.

abilities.name: enigma_demonic_conversion
abilities.desc_loc: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
abilities.lore_loc: Enigma is capable of drawing aspects of himself from other dimensions - the result is a trio of dark eidolons that hunt the corporeal plane.

abilities.name: enigma_midnight_pulse
abilities.desc_loc: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing %base_damage% + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
abilities.lore_loc: A section of the world slowly descends into the void.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.

abilities.name: enigma_event_horizon
abilities.desc_loc: Units in a %radius% radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

abilities.name: enigma_black_hole
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
abilities.lore_loc: The ground trembles as Enigma channels his ultimate vortex of destruction, a singularity with the power to end worlds.
abilities.scepter_loc: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to %scepter_pct_damage%%% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a %scepter_radius% AoE. Pulls at a rate of %scepter_drag_speed%.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_tinker
data.bio_loc: Boush the Tinker's diminutive race is known for its intelligence, its cunning, and its prickly relationship with magic. As a matter of pride, they survive by their wits, and use only those powers of nature that may be unlocked through rational methodologies. Even this forbearance has led to a great deal of trouble, as Boush can attest. Once a key investigator of natural law, Boush the Tinker led a vast intellectual investigation into the workings of nature, founding a subterranean laboratory in the rumored, mist-wreathed wastes of the Violet Plateau. While scorning mages for the dangers they visit upon the world, Boush and his Tinker associates haughtily wrenched open a portal to some realm beyond comprehension and ushered in some nightmares of their own. A black mist rose from the cavernous interior of the Violet Plateau, shrouding it in permanent darkness from which sounds of horror perpetually emanate. Boush escaped with only his wits and the contraptions he carried, the sole Tinker to survive the Violet Plateau Incident.
data.hype_loc: Tinker demolishes foes with swarms of machines and a host of deadly gadgets. If he can gather the resources he needs, the power that instantly refreshes his abilities enables him to lead his team from every front.
data.npe_desc_loc: Demolishes his enemies with swarms of machines

abilities.name: tinker_laser
abilities.desc_loc: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
abilities.lore_loc: Boush perfected this rock cutting laser in his subterranean laboratory, never considering its combat utility.
abilities.scepter_loc: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

abilities.name: tinker_march_of_the_machines
abilities.desc_loc: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
abilities.lore_loc: Even though the laboratory has since been sealed off, the ability to radio in robotic drones is still in working order.
notes_loc: Robots spawn at a rate of %machines_per_sec% per second.
abilities.scepter_loc: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
facets_loc: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.

abilities.name: tinker_deploy_turrets
abilities.desc_loc: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.
abilities.scepter_loc: Turrets fire missiles %missile_attack_rate_tooltip%%% faster.

abilities.name: tinker_warp_grenade
abilities.desc_loc:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
abilities.lore_loc: Tinker's deadliest weapon instantly turns an enemy into space dust. Research to resolve the annoying 'perfect copy' side effect... is ongoing.
notes_loc: Max teleportation distance is %warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.

abilities.name: tinker_rearm
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.
abilities.lore_loc: A new battery here, another set of rockets there, Boush continually improves on existing technology.

abilities.name: tinker_eureka
abilities.desc_loc: Tinker gains %one_percent_tooltip%%% item cooldown reduction per %int_per_one_cdr% Intelligence, up to a maximum of %max_cdr%%%.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_sniper
data.bio_loc:
Kardel Sharpeye was born deep in the mountains of Knollen where, since time immemorial, Keen Folk have survived by hunting the strange, cliff-dwelling steepstalkers above their village, shooting them from a distance and collecting the carcasses where they fell. Sharpeye was among the best of these strange mountain keens for whom projectile weapons are but another appendage, and to shoot is as natural as to touch.

On his day of summoning, when he was to gain full standing in his village, Sharpeye took the ancient test: a single shot from the valley floor to strike a beast down from the cliffs. To miss was to be dishonored. With his entire village standing vigil, Sharpeye took his shot. A steepstalker fell; the crowd cheered. But when the carcass was collected, the village grew silent, for the elders found that the bullet had pierced its glittering central eye then fallen to be clenched in the steepstalker's mandibles. This ominous sign was the literal opening of a dark prophecy, foretelling both greatness and exile for the gunman who made such a shot. Sharpeye the Sniper was thus, by his own skill, condemned to make his way apart from his people--and unwelcome back among them until he has fulfilled the remainder of the prophecy by attaining legendary stature on a field of battle.
data.hype_loc: Death from a distance is Sniper's specialty. He keeps his enemies on their toes with a steady barrage of firepower, and then, when the time is right, picks them off with a kill shot.
data.npe_desc_loc: Picks off his enemies from afar

abilities.name: sniper_shrapnel
abilities.desc_loc: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every %abilitychargerestoretime% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Kardel's modular rifle also fires incendiary rounds, useful for assaulting entrenched locations.
notes_loc: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
Does not damage buildings.
Provides vision in the targeted area.
facets_loc: Shrapnel slow and damage are increased, but duration is decreased.

abilities.name: sniper_headshot
abilities.desc_loc: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal %damage% extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by %slow%%%.
abilities.lore_loc: Taking potshots at steepstalkers in his childhood has been thoroughly refined into perfect leads on enemy combatants.

abilities.name: sniper_take_aim
abilities.desc_loc:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by %passive_attack_range_bonus%.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.
abilities.lore_loc: Kardel always takes it upon himself to stay as far from harm as he can while still performing his role - taking perfect aim.

abilities.name: sniper_concussive_grenade
abilities.desc_loc: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
abilities.lore_loc: ATTN: IN CASE OF DANGER PULL PIN
abilities.shard_loc: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.

abilities.name: sniper_keen_scope
abilities.desc_loc: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every %bonus_damage_distance% units of distance Sniper is from the target.

abilities.name: sniper_assassinate
abilities.desc_loc: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
abilities.lore_loc: In order to fulfill the prophecy and return to his home town, Kardel must make another shot as perfect as the one on the day of his ancient test.
notes_loc: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.
abilities.scepter_loc: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.

officialDataset.interpretation: Official website declarations, retained in full; not an assertion of complete engine verification.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_necrolyte
data.bio_loc: In a time of great plague, an obscure monk of dark inclinations, one Rotund'jere, found himself promoted to the rank of Cardinal by the swift death of all his superiors. While others of the order went out to succor the ill, the newly ordained cardinal secluded himself within the Cathedral of Rumusque, busily scheming to acquire the property of dying nobles, promising them spiritual rewards if they signed over their terrestrial domains. As the plague receded to a few stubborn pockets, his behavior came to the attention of the greater order, which found him guilty of heresy and sentenced him to serve in the plague ward, ensorcelled with spells that would ensure him a slow and lingering illness. But they had not counted on his natural immunity. Rotund'jere caught the pox, but instead of dying, found it feeding his power, transforming him into a veritable plague-mage, a Pope of Pestilence. Proclaiming himself Necrophos, he travels the world, spreading plague wherever he goes, and growing in terrible power with every village his pestilential presence obliterates.
data.hype_loc: Wherever Necrophos goes, enemies wither as allies thrive. Restoring health to his friends and harming enemies with each death pulse, once his very presence has eaten away at an enemy, he summons the reaper to lengthen their stay in the afterlife.
data.npe_desc_loc: Damages enemies and heals allies simultaneously

abilities.name: necrolyte_death_pulse
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
abilities.lore_loc: Poor souls who succumb to Rotund'jere's plagues are recycled for future use.
notes_loc: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.

abilities.name: necrolyte_ghost_shroud
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
abilities.lore_loc: Rotund'jere uses the souls of his victims as bridge from life to afterlife.
facets_loc: Necrophos gains movement speed equal to %movement_transfer%%% of the movement speed lost by enemies. Enemies lose %enemies_negative_heal_bonus_as_pct_of_self%%% of the restoration amplification gained by Necrophos.

abilities.name: necrolyte_heartstopper_aura
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
abilities.lore_loc: Those who come within a short distance of Necrophos can feel pestilence and plague in the air.
notes_loc: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.
abilities.scepter_loc: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by %heal_regen_to_damage%%% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

abilities.name: necrolyte_death_seeker
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
abilities.lore_loc: The Rumusque Faithful consider Necrophos to be more plague than person.
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell reflect.

abilities.name: necrolyte_sadist
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos gains stacking regen for %regen_duration% seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
abilities.desc_loc: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
abilities.lore_loc: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of Necrophos's plague magic.
notes_loc: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_warlock
data.bio_loc: As Chief Curator and Head of Acquisitions for the Arcane Archives of the Ultimyr Academy, Demnok Lannik was tireless in his pursuit of lost, rare and forbidden tomes. No cursed temple was so foreboding, no cavern path so treacherous, that any concern for his own survival could dissuade him from entering if rumors hinted that some pamphlet of primordial lore might still survive in its depths. However, so often did his investigations trigger the wrath of protector entities, that he finally found it necessary to master the arts of magic. He bent himself to learning sorcery with the same thorough obsessiveness that marked his quest for incunabula, becoming the most powerful Warlock of the Academy in less time than most practitioners required to complete a course of undergraduate work. Almost as an afterthought, he carved a staff of Dreadwood and summoned into it a captive spirit from the Outer Hells. And anticipating the day when he will have recovered every last lost spellbook, he has commenced writing his own Black Grimoire. It will undoubtedly be instructive.
data.hype_loc: Summoning forth his demonic golem, Warlock brings ruin to enemies and destroys their defenses. Yet even without his golem, his dark spells can still wreak havoc, whether healing allies and harming enemies with a word, or binding foes together to share their agony.
data.npe_desc_loc: Summons powerful demons to fight at his side

abilities.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
abilities.desc_loc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
abilities.lore_loc: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.
notes_loc: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: warlock_shadow_word
abilities.desc_loc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
abilities.lore_loc: Demnok's arcane arts have a myriad of uses, allowing them to be powerful friendly enchantments or damaging curses.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.

abilities.name: warlock_upheaval
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
abilities.lore_loc: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.
notes_loc: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
abilities.shard_loc: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

abilities.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.

abilities.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
abilities.lore_loc: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
abilities.scepter_loc: Calls %number_of_golems_scepter% Golems.
facets_loc: Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_beastmaster
data.bio_loc:
Karroch was born a child of the stocks. His mother died in childbirth; his father, a farrier for the Last King of Slom, was trampled to death when he was five. Afterward Karroch was indentured to the king's menagerie, where he grew up among all the beasts of the royal court: lions, apes, fell-deer, and things less known, things barely believed in. When the lad was seven, an explorer brought in a beast like none before seen. Dragged before the King in chains, the beast spoke, though its mouth moved not. Its words: a plea for freedom. The King only laughed and ordered the beast perform for his amusement; and when it refused, struck it with the Mad Scepter and ordered it dragged to the stocks.

Over the coming months, the boy Karroch sneaked food and medicinal draughts to the wounded creature, but only managed to slow its deterioration. Wordlessly, the beast spoke to the boy, and over time their bond strengthened until the boy found he could hold up his end of a conversation. He could, in fact, speak now to all the creatures of the King's menagerie. On the night the beast died, a rage came over the boy. He incited the animals of the court to rebel and threw open their cages to set them amok on the palace grounds. The Last King was mauled in the mayhem. In the chaos, one regal stag bowed to the boy who had freed him; and with Beastmaster astride him, leapt the high walls of the estate, and escaped. Now a man, Karroch the Beastmaster has not lost his ability to converse with wild creatures. He has grown into a warrior at one with nature's savagery.
data.hype_loc: Summoning a poison-spitting boar and a scouting hawk to aid his hunt, Beastmaster never stalks the battlefield unprepared. Chopping through the forest with his axes, his stunning roar opens the way for his allies to devastate enemies.
data.npe_desc_loc: Summons beasts to aid his hunt

abilities.name: beastmaster_wild_axes
abilities.desc_loc: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
abilities.lore_loc: While learning to maneuver in nature alone, the Beastmaster also mastered the use of a pair of tomahawks, adept at cutting down trees as well as adversaries.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees.
abilities.shard_loc: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.

abilities.name: beastmaster_summon_razorback
abilities.desc_loc: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.
abilities.lore_loc: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.

abilities.name: beastmaster_summon_raptor
abilities.desc_loc: Beastmaster summons %hawk_count% hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every %hawk_base_attack_interval%s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
abilities.lore_loc: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases Hawk duration by %bonus_duration%s and summons an additional Hawk.

abilities.name: beastmaster_inner_beast
abilities.desc_loc: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
abilities.lore_loc: Beastmaster's ability to incite the innate strength of animals was seen in the mauling of the king of Slom.
notes_loc: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.
facets_loc: Attack Speed bonus is increased by the number of units affected by Inner Beast.
Can be activated to increase Beastmaster's attack speed and allow him to apply the Wild Axes damage amplification debuff on his attack target.

abilities.name: beastmaster_drums_of_slom
abilities.desc_loc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of %min_drum_hit_interval%s between hits after %max_stacks% attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as %primal_roar_stacks% attacks.
abilities.lore_loc: Nature's rage is timeless, and for those who know the secrets, it's easy to stir the echoes of ire that rejoiced in the downfall of Slom.

abilities.name: beastmaster_primal_roar
abilities.desc_loc: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain %movement_speed%%% movement speed for %movement_speed_duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: The Beastmaster has learned to channel his primal instincts into an animalistic roar, causing devastation in the ranks of enemies.

talents.desc_loc: The Movespeed Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.
