data.name: npc_dota_hero_ringmaster
data.bio_loc:
Welcome, welcome, one and all — to a stage-lit extravaganza for the ages! Prepare to have your senses shattered! Your expectations demolished! Your Ancients smashed to ruins!

Witness the impossible feats and derring-do of the one and only clockwork marvel, the Great Cogliostro Kettle — Ringmaster, torture artist, genius in his own time — here now for the sole agony and entertainment of any hero bold enough to draw back the crimson carnival curtain and behold what mysteries await inside.

The mistake most maestros make is waiting for the public to come to them. The Ringmaster knows you need to go out and find your audience! Drag them to you. And make them watch.
data.hype_loc: All the battlefield's a stage, and Ringmaster is a gleeful director. Controlling fights with a showman's flair, Ringmaster tames enemies with his fearsome whip and endless knives, ushers allies away from danger with his cunning escape act, and always draws a crowd to unwillingly witness the wonders of his mesmerizing wheel.
data.npe_desc_loc: Directs the battle with fear and mesmerism

abilities.name: ringmaster_tame_the_beasts
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.
abilities.lore_loc: From unhappy crowds to unruly acts, nothing persuades a pack of animals quite like the crack of the Ringmaster's whip.

abilities.name: ringmaster_the_box
abilities.desc_loc: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
abilities.lore_loc: An adept assistant has nothing to fear within the confines of The Box. An amateur has...much darker prospects indeed.
abilities.scepter_loc: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

abilities.name: ringmaster_impalement
abilities.desc_loc: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
abilities.lore_loc: Passed down through generations, it simply wouldn't be a Kettle Circus without the Great Cogliostro's signature trick.

abilities.name: ringmaster_spotlight
abilities.desc_loc: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.
abilities.lore_loc: Are you ready for your fifteen seconds? The limelight draws no distinction between infamy and fame.

abilities.name: ringmaster_wheel
abilities.desc_loc:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: No, brave friends, illusions are for charlatans and card sharks. What you witness today is the power of true magic. But only if you dare set your gaze upon...the mesmerizing wheel.

abilities.name: ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs
abilities.desc_loc:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.
facets_loc: Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Funhouse Mirror, Strongman Tonic, and Whoopee Cushion.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Crystal Ball, Unicycle, and Weighted Pie.

abilities.name: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
abilities.desc_loc:
Use: Proportion Distortion

Creates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
notes_loc: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

abilities.name: ringmaster_strongman_tonic
abilities.desc_loc:
Use: Forcefully Imbibe

Temporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

abilities.name: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion
abilities.desc_loc:
Use: Whoopsie

Propels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.

abilities.name: ringmaster_summon_unicycle
abilities.desc_loc:
Use: Saddle Up

Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_whip_debuff_immunity
talents.name_loc: Debuff Immunity While Channeling Tame the Beasts
talents.desc_loc: Also grants {s:bonus_magic_resist}% magic resistance.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_dagger_bleed_and_slow_duration
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bleed_duration}s Impalement Arts Bleed and Slow Duration

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_wheel_radius
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_mesmerize_radius} Wheel of Wonder Radius and Range

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_the_box_strong_dispel_and_flying
talents.name_loc: Escape Act Grants Strong Dispel and Flying

data.name: npc_dota_hero_dawnbreaker
data.bio_loc:
In the aeons after the Keeper's exodus birthed the age of light, some amongst the first sun's lineage began to align against the chaos their ancestor's maker left chasing in his wake. Calling themselves the Children of Light, they saw no one else as worthy of taking up the Keeper's abandoned mantle, and they yearned to beat back the onslaught of darkness, creating glorious armies built to purge the cosmos of all creatures of primordial night.

Valora, the Dawnbreaker, most prized warrior amongst the Children's ancient creations, is the shining herald of the majesty of order and light. Molded from the heart of a young metallic star, and charged by golden breath with new life, Valora was called to spread the glow of the Children's wisdom to the darkest reaches of the universe — setting fire to the heavens with each swing of her celestial hammer amidst an endless battle to keep chaos at bay.

In time, the Children also revealed another purpose for the Dawnbreaker. They had discovered a means of permeating the entirety of the cosmos with their inner light — to obliterate all aspects of darkness forever — and they sent Valora to seize a source of great power, the final piece of their ultimate plan. But for the first time, Valora and her hammer met with failure, and the price she and her masters paid was vast. The Children of Light's spark was utterly extinguished, and the Dawnbreaker was left adrift in a black expanse, lost for untold millennia before crashing on an unfamiliar world.

There she rested, dormant, until the presence of a wandering young star gave fuel to an ancient energy forge — a relic of the Children's that, like her, lay buried for countless ages beneath a blowing red waste. Now, with a small measure of her former powers restored by the forge, Valora wakes to a land beset by war and the unrelenting forces of chaos. She knows her gods may be gone, but the heft of the Dawnbreaker's hammer remains — matched only by her will to wield it justly in the name of goodness and light.
data.hype_loc: Dawnbreaker shines in the heart of battle, happily crushing enemies with her celestial hammer and healing nearby allies. She revels in hurling her hammer through multiple foes and then converging with it in a blazing wake, always waiting to tap her true cosmic power to fly to the aid of her teammates — eager to rout her enemies on the battlefield no matter where they are.
data.npe_desc_loc: Leaps to aid her allies, wherever they are on the map

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_fire_wreath
abilities.desc_loc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
abilities.lore_loc: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organize defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.
notes_loc: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of %movement_speed% for the duration of the ability and takes a brief %self_stun_duration%s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by %swipe_slow%%% for %sweep_stun_duration%s.
abilities.shard_loc: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
facets_loc: Dawnbreaker and her allies in a %movespeed_bonus_radius% radius gain attack speed for %movespeed_bonus_duration% seconds at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer
abilities.desc_loc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
abilities.lore_loc: The Brightmaul is Valora's oldest companion and sole remaining connection to the glow of her creators.
notes_loc: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
facets_loc: When Celestial Hammer lands on the ground, it creates the healing and damaging effects of Solar Guardian, reduced by %hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%% in a %hammer_solar_guardian_radius% AoE around it. Increases the duration that the hammer can remain stationary to %pause_duration%s.
Allied heroes walking on Celestial Hammer's fire trail gain bonus movement speed.

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_luminosity
abilities.desc_loc: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
abilities.lore_loc: Diminished in power without access to the Children's replenishing light, Valora can still recharge herself and her allies by creating order from the chaos which resides within each fight.
notes_loc: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
abilities.scepter_loc: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
facets_loc: Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
abilities.scepter_loc: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_solar_guardian
abilities.desc_loc:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
abilities.lore_loc: Only in defense of an ally will Valora relent to call upon the last reserves of her old powers that still allow cosmic flight.
notes_loc: Pulse interval is %pulse_interval%s.
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
abilities.scepter_loc: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer_targets_allies
talents.name_loc: Celestial Hammer Trail Grants Movement Speed to Allies
talents.desc_loc: Bonus movement speed is equal to the movement slow

data.name: npc_dota_hero_marci
data.bio_loc: Admired by many, Marci's origins are known to nameless few. She travels mostly in the company of the Princess Mirana, but the roots of their friendship are entwined in secrets neither would ever needlessly reveal. To allies, she serves as fierce and honest companion. To enemies, she acts as dauntless deterrence against harming any she deems friend. Though unwise opponents may consider her size unremarkable, Marci possesses an inner power that imbues her strikes with incredible might. She'll decimate those who think to test her, but those who earn her favor will have an unflappable confidant for life.
data.hype_loc: Proving that undying loyalty yields unrivaled power, Marci always marches into battle ready to raise fists in defense of her companions. Effortlessly flinging friends and foes around the battlefield, she happily bounds into any brawl, able to grant allies a deadly edge and unleash a hidden power strong enough to make even gods reconsider the wisdom of a hostile path.
data.npe_desc_loc: Dashes around pummeling enemies with rapid attacks

abilities.name: marci_grapple
abilities.desc_loc: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
abilities.lore_loc: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.

abilities.name: marci_companion_run
abilities.desc_loc:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
abilities.lore_loc: With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.
notes_loc: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.
facets_loc:
When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination. The ally deals %ally_impact_damage_pct%%% of the Rebound damage to the enemies around it's destination.

 Will not apply to Rooted or Leashed allies.

If Marci has Unleash leveled, after landing from Rebound, Marci gains a %postjump_flurry_charges% strike Fury combo. If Unleash is already active, its duration is instead extended by %postjump_unleash_duration%s.

 If upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter, the resulting Unleashed pulse will not silence enemies.

abilities.name: marci_bodyguard
abilities.desc_loc:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
abilities.lore_loc: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.
notes_loc: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.
facets_loc: While bodyguarded, Marci and her partner share %shared_healing_percent%%% of health healed by this ability with each other.

abilities.name: marci_special_delivery
abilities.desc_loc:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers %bonus_levels% bonus levels and %bonus_hp_tooltip% bonus health.
abilities.lore_loc: Professional courtesy, from one courier to another.
notes_loc: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.

abilities.name: marci_unleash
abilities.desc_loc:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
abilities.lore_loc: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.
notes_loc: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.
abilities.scepter_loc:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_marci_guardian_damage
facets_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_damage}% Bodyguard Damage

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_marci_unleash_extend_duration
talents.name_loc: Unleash Duration Extended By {s:bonus_extend_duration}s On Kill

data.name: npc_dota_hero_primal_beast
data.bio_loc:
Though the deterioration of the Mistwood and its evolution from idyllic expanse to death-filled tanglewild was a slow, wizard-fueled process, most scholars agree the true beginning of the end was marked by the interdimensional arrival of the Primal Beast.

A creature hatched into an existence devoid of all feeling but hunger and pain, aeons of carnage shaped the Primal Beast into the apex predator on a planet filled with violent terrors. Desperately banished by would-be masters with failed hopes to control him, the Beast was cast into a new world — one where he could ascend from mere hungry predator into an invasive killing machine with nothing able to stand in his way.

For thousands of years, the Mistwood served as massive stomping ground for the Beast's destructive play — and even the feared durana beasts made for tasty snacks. Indeed, there could be no rivals for the Beast's territory, only minor annoyances. Until one such tiny annoyance employed vile trickery to trap the unstoppable Beast in the Gleipnir.

There he might have remained subdued for eternity, were it not for the unpredictable powers of the Continuum Device. Now, freed from both Gleipnir and Vault, far afield from the Mistwood, and much closer to inhabited lands, the Beast sets his snout towards new slaughters and the delights of savage destruction — and the paltry fires of civilization will do little to keep this ageless monster at bay.
data.hype_loc: Rushing savagely through enemies and allies alike, Primal Beast pounds into battle as one born to raise a ruckus. An unavoidable threat amidst any fray, the Beast can punish attackers and relishes grabbing prey to repeatedly slam them against the ground until nothing but mush remains.
data.npe_desc_loc: Stomps over everything and smashes enemies into messy bits

abilities.name: primal_beast_onslaught
abilities.desc_loc:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
abilities.lore_loc: The Beast's single-minded focus on chosen prey leaves all other considerations scattered in his ruinous wake.

abilities.name: primal_beast_trample
abilities.desc_loc: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every %step_distance% units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.
abilities.lore_loc: As the only member of his species to arrive on this world, locals can only speculate on the Beast's size relative to his kin. Such observation would prove easier of course if the subject didn't eat everything it sees and destroy most of what it doesn't.
facets_loc: Trample grants bonus movement speed to Primal Beast and his allies when activated.

abilities.name: primal_beast_uproar
abilities.desc_loc:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
abilities.lore_loc: Already draped in a broken patchwork of barding and chains upon appearing in the mistwoods, the Beast tolerates no further attempts at subjugation.
notes_loc: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
abilities.scepter_loc: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.

abilities.name: primal_beast_rock_throw
abilities.desc_loc:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
abilities.lore_loc: AGAIN WITH THE ROCKS!

abilities.name: primal_beast_pulverize
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Though none are certain whether his utterances have true meaning, most concede the Beast's powerful grip and tendency to smash his enemies into naught but pulp and pieces communicates his intent well enough.

abilities.name: primal_beast_colossal
abilities.desc_loc: Primal Beast has %base_slow_resist%%% base Slow Resistance and gains %aoe_per_threshold%%% bonus Area of Effect and %slow_resistance_per_threshold%%% Slow Resistance for every %hp_per_threshold% Max Health.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_muerta
data.bio_loc:
There are as many stories about Muerta as there are graves in the Carrion Fields of Gorm. Some tell their children ghost stories of a young peasant girl returned from the dead to punish the bandits who killed her family. Others, drunk in dark taverns, slur conspiracy theories about kidnappings and phantom guilds of killers.

One constant bleeds through every tale: of a woman so consumed by hate for those who killed her that she refused to die. And of Death, so impressed by whatever hate-filled engine that drove this woman that he gave her Mercy and Grace — twin ethereal pistols — and made her his second in command. Now she hunts down wayward souls whose last grains have tumbled from their hourglass, and drags them kicking and screaming to their eternal reward.
data.hype_loc: Muerta is a master of death who stalks the lands of life, corralling targets with fearsome trickshots and summoning revenants to smother her foes. Always ready to pick off unwary targets with her spare gunhand, Muerta is at her most menacing when she crosses the veil of the dead to strike her enemies with the ethereal fury of the damned.
data.npe_desc_loc: Blasts fearsome trickshots and unleashes ethereal ruin

abilities.name: muerta_dead_shot
abilities.desc_loc:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
abilities.lore_loc: A steady gunhand and an eternity of practice produce trickshots that defy the mortal mind.
notes_loc: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
abilities.scepter_loc: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
facets_loc: Dead Shot fears increase Gunslinger chance to %gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%x for %gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%s.

abilities.name: muerta_the_calling
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
abilities.lore_loc: Muerta's family are forever beyond the spirit veil, but her deal with Death allows her to briefly call on them in times of want or need.
facets_loc: Heroes killed inside The Calling refresh its duration, create another Revenant, and expand the radius of The Calling by %kill_radius_expansion%.

abilities.name: muerta_gunslinger
abilities.desc_loc: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
abilities.lore_loc: Muerta offers all of her victims Mercy. Some are fortunate enough to also earn Grace.
notes_loc: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus %target_search_bonus_range%.
The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.
facets_loc: Gunslinger procs reduce Dead Shot cooldown by %dead_shot_cooldown_reduction_on_proc%s.

abilities.name: muerta_spectral_slug
abilities.desc_loc: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for %duration%s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.

abilities.name: muerta_pierce_the_veil
abilities.desc_loc:
Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.

Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: Muerta sheds her corporeal form, crossing the spirit veil and striking her enemies with the fury of the damned.
notes_loc: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.
abilities.shard_loc:
Muerta gains %spell_lifesteal%%% Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.
While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains %spell_amp_steal%%% spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.

abilities.name: muerta_supernatural
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever an enemy hero dies within %stack_collection_range% units of Muerta, she gains a stack of %spell_amp_per_stack%%% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_muerta_calling_hp_regen
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_hp_regen_pct}% Max HP Regen while inside The Calling
talents.desc_loc: Only applies to Muerta.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_kez
data.bio_loc: "I was born with a price on my head. As I got better at causing trouble, that price went up. Every time Queen Imperia raised the bounty, I knew I must have done something right. I think that's the worst part about being gone so long in Icewrack... I've got to get that price back up to a respectable number."
data.hype_loc: When it comes to strategy, Kez tends to wing it — he's able to swap on the fly between his katana and sai to slash, dash, swoop, and parry as the needs of the battlefield demand. But when he puts his mind to it, he can account for any eventuality, choosing the right tool to attack, escape or simply outwit his enemies with a little advance planning.
data.npe_desc_loc: Flexible melee master with two sets of weapons and abilities

abilities.name: kez_echo_slash
abilities.desc_loc: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
abilities.lore_loc: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.
notes_loc: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.

abilities.name: kez_grappling_claw
abilities.desc_loc: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
abilities.lore_loc: The Kazurai have the speed and reach to drag even the highest flyers from the skies.

abilities.name: kez_kazurai_katana
abilities.desc_loc:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time.

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
abilities.lore_loc: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.
abilities.shard_loc: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

abilities.name: kez_switch_weapons
abilities.desc_loc:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
abilities.lore_loc: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.
abilities.scepter_loc:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

abilities.name: kez_raptor_dance
abilities.desc_loc:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
abilities.lore_loc: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.
notes_loc: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing a creep or an illusion.

abilities.name: kez_falcon_rush
abilities.desc_loc: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
abilities.lore_loc: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.
notes_loc: Does not work on buildings.

abilities.name: kez_talon_toss
abilities.desc_loc: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
abilities.lore_loc: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.
notes_loc: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.

abilities.name: kez_shodo_sai
abilities.desc_loc:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
abilities.lore_loc: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
abilities.shard_loc: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

abilities.name: kez_ravens_veil
abilities.desc_loc: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
abilities.lore_loc: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.
facets_loc: Increases Raven's Veil invisibility duration.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_kez_falcon_rush_attack_speed
talents.name_loc: {s:bonus_bonus_attack_speed} Bonus Attack Speed During Falcon Rush

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_kez_echo_slash_strike_count
talents.desc_loc: -0.6s Interval

data.name: npc_dota_hero_largo
data.bio_loc: The exiled Murkroots of Velu’Mar discovered a living island so ancient it speaks only in song. Raised among the shamanic bards who learned to commune with it, Largo now roams the realms with a troupe of frogling disciples, looking for inspiration for new melodies to bring back and share with his island home.
data.hype_loc: With his slick-strumming fingers and sticky-whip tongue, Largo is always ready to grant his team damage, healing, or speed and dispel friends or foes using just the right lick.
data.npe_desc_loc: Strums music to empower allies and can dispel with a lick

abilities.name: largo_catchy_lick
abilities.desc_loc:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: After generations spent living on the ancient isaloth Velu'Mar, the descendants of the Murkroot exiles have grown resilient, happily sampling toxins that would've struck their ancestors dead.
notes_loc: Can lick runes to pull them.

abilities.name: largo_frogstomp
abilities.desc_loc: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.
abilities.lore_loc: Most Bard Monks spend decades mastering the musical arts, but even the top frog Largo has to admit that his young disciples have already grown shockingly good at counting a proper beat.

abilities.name: largo_croak_of_genius
abilities.desc_loc:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
abilities.lore_loc: Largo loves to help his friends find glory through the power of music, never missing a chance at a killer duet.
notes_loc: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within %max_distance% units of each other.

abilities.name: largo_encore
abilities.desc_loc: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
abilities.shard_loc:
Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.

If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.

abilities.name: largo_amphibian_rhapsody
abilities.desc_loc:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
abilities.lore_loc: The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.
notes_loc: Items can be used while in this mode.
abilities.scepter_loc: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.

special_values.name: song_cost_reduction_per_stack_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK:

abilities.name: largo_song_fight_song
abilities.desc_loc: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
abilities.lore_loc: 'Hey, when a beach brawl breaks out, you gotta learn to throw your musical weight around or the party's over proper quick.'
abilities.scepter_loc: Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.

abilities.name: largo_song_double_time
abilities.desc_loc: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.
abilities.lore_loc: 'It's like that old story about the scary swamp witch. You better watch just where you're jumping when you're trying to do it lickety-split.'

abilities.name: largo_song_good_vibrations
abilities.desc_loc: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
abilities.lore_loc: 'If this song can heal an ageless isaloth, it can handle a few cuts and bruises on the lot of you.'
